title: RIFT-Bench: Dynamic Red-teaming For Agentic AI Systems
summary: Agentic AI systems powered by large language models (LLMs) are rapidly evolving into autonomous decision-making systems, exposing attack vectors beyond those of traditional LLM vulnerabilities. Existing security evaluations are often tied to specific implementations or domains, limiting unified comparison across heterogeneous systems. To address this gap, we introduce RIFT-Bench, a graph representation-driven methodology for dynamic red-teaming that enables unified evaluations across diverse agentic architectures. Building on a novel hierarchical representation, RIFT-Bench operates in two automated phases: Discovery, which extracts system structure, and Scanning, which deploys adaptive adversarial attacks and produces a comprehensive evaluation report. It evaluates the examined system itself, leveraging a broad set of dynamically adaptable adversarial probes across diverse attack vectors and objectives. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed evaluation pipeline across 45 agentic systems spanning a diverse range of implementations, showing that the approach generalizes effectively to heterogeneous agentic architectures. Beyond systems and attacks, RIFT-Bench also supports direct evaluation of mitigation strategies. These key capabilities make RIFT-Bench a scalable foundation for security evaluation of agentic AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RIFT-Bench，一种基于图表示的动态红队测试方法，用于统一评估异构Agentic AI系统的安全性，包含自动化的系统结构发现和自适应对抗攻击部署两个阶段。
AI.motivation: 现有安全评估方法往往绑定于特定实现或领域，缺乏统一的跨异构系统比较框架，而大语言模型驱动的Agentic AI系统正演变为自主决策系统，暴露出传统LLM漏洞之外的新型攻击面。
AI.method: 提出RIFT-Bench框架，采用分层图表示方法，包含两个自动化阶段：Discovery阶段提取系统结构，Scanning阶段部署自适应对抗攻击并生成综合评估报告。通过大规模可动态适应的对抗探针，覆盖多种攻击向量和目标。
AI.result: 在45个覆盖多种实现的Agentic系统上验证了有效性，证明该方法能够有效泛化至异构Agentic架构，并支持直接评估缓解策略。
AI.conclusion: RIFT-Bench为Agentic AI系统的安全评估提供了可扩展的基础框架，能够统一评估异构系统并支持缓解策略评估。

A two-phase automated pipeline comprising Discovery (system structure extraction) and Scanning (adaptive adversarial attack deployment and report generation)
A hierarchical representation framework for modeling diverse agentic AI architectures in a unified graph structure
A dynamically adaptable adversarial probe mechanism covering multiple attack vectors and objectives for comprehensive security assessment
A cross-system generalizable evaluation methodology validated across 45 heterogeneous agentic systems

title: Neuro-Symbolic Drive: Rule-Grounded Faithful Reasoning for Driving VLAs
summary: Driving VLA models incorporating Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning are attractive because they leverage pretrained VLM representations and expose intermediate decisions in natural language, yet current rationales often lack the step-by-step decision semantics needed to keep the rationale causally connected to the planned motion. We introduce Neuro-Symbolic Drive, a neuro-symbolic driving framework that supervises a driving VLA with rule-grounded reasoning traces extracted directly from classical rule-based planners. Our key observation is that rule-based planners are symbolic AI systems that already function as executable reasoning engines: they reason about active safety constraints, search over candidate maneuvers, and select a final trajectory. We instrument these planners in simulation to capture both the executed trajectory and the internal decision trace at each rule-evaluation step. Each trace is serialized into structured rule-grounded reasoning and paired with the trajectory to fine-tune Qwen3.5-4B as a driving VLA. Because these traces are derived directly from the planner states that determine the action, they ensure reasoning is structurally coupled to motion generation by construction, rather than by post-hoc alignment. On our simulator-generated benchmark, detailed rule-grounded reasoning reduces ADE@3s from 0.47 to 0.26 and miss rate from 8.30% to 6.40% under three-camera perception, and from 0.54 to 0.26 and 10.13% to 5.99% under eight-camera perception. Neuro-Symbolic Drive thus converts neuro-symbolic planning logic into structured supervision. Code base: https://github.com/XiangboGaoBarry/Neural-Symbolic-Drive.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Neuro-Symbolic Drive框架，通过从经典规则规划器中提取规则约束的推理轨迹，监督驾驶VLA模型进行链式思维推理，确保推理与运动生成因果耦合，显著提升了轨迹预测精度。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶VLA模型虽结合CoT推理，但推理过程缺乏与规划运动因果连接的逐步决策语义，导致推理与动作脱节。
AI.method: 在仿真中改造规则规划器，捕获执行轨迹及每个规则评估步骤的内部决策轨迹，将其序列化为结构化规则推理文本，与轨迹配对微调Qwen3.5-4B作为驾驶VLA模型。
AI.result: 在仿真基准上，三摄像头场景ADE@3s从0.47降至0.26，miss rate从8.30%降至6.40%；八摄像头场景ADE@3s从0.54降至0.26，miss rate从10.13%降至5.99%。
AI.conclusion: Neuro-Symbolic Drive将神经符号规划逻辑转化为结构化监督，通过规则推理轨迹实现了推理与运动生成的因果耦合，显著提升了驾驶决策性能。

A neuro-symbolic driving VLA training framework where rule-grounded reasoning traces extracted from symbolic planners are paired with trajectories to fine-tune a VLM, ensuring structural coupling between reasoning and motion generation.

A system that converts neuro-symbolic planning logic into structured supervision by using rule-based planner states as ground-truth reasoning data for training driving VLA models with chain-of-thought reasoning.

A method for improving trajectory prediction in autonomous driving by supervising VLA models with causal reasoning traces derived directly from the planner states that determine the executed action, rather than post-hoc alignment.

title: Critique of Agent Model
summary: What is an agent? What constitutes agency? With the rise of Large Language Model (LLM) systems marketed as ``coding agents'', ``AI co-scientists'', and other ``agentic" tools that promise to drive up productivity, and at the same time, ``existential" concerns such as AI escaping human control with destructive power under a speculative ``machine agency" against humans, it has become essential to clarify where automation ends and agency begins, both for building capable systems and for understanding whether and what to fear. Drawing on Descartes' grounding of agency in independent thought, and on portrayals of autonomous beings in science fiction, we survey the current landscape of AI agents, and analyze agent architectures along five dimensions: goal, identity, decision-making, self-regulation, and learning. Specifically, we argue that genuine agency requires these structures to be \emph{internalized within the system itself} rather than assembled through external scaffolding. This distinction between \emph{agentic} systems, whose competence resides in engineered workflows, and \emph{agentive} systems, whose capabilities (including social interaction) arise endogenously, defines the boundary between systems designed for prescribed tasks, and those capable of operating in the open world with true autonomy. Building on this analysis, we propose the Goal-Identity-Configurator (GIC) architecture for a general-purpose agent model, combining hierarchical goal decomposition, identity evolution, simulative reasoning grounded in a separately trained world model, learned self-regulation, and self-directed learning from both real and simulated experience. Furthermore, we share insight on the auditability, controllability, and safety of agentive systems that possess greater autonomy and ``agency", but remain under human oversight.

AI.tldr: 本文从哲学和科幻视角出发，提出区分"agentic"（外部工程编排）与"agentive"（内生自主能力）两类AI系统，并设计了一种名为Goal-Identity-Configurator (GIC)的通用智能体架构，强调真正的自主性需要目标、身份、决策、自我调节和学习等机制内化于系统本身。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM系统被营销为"编程智能体"、"AI合作科学家"等，同时出现AI脱离人类控制的"存在性担忧"，亟需厘清自动化与自主性的边界，以指导系统构建和风险评估。
AI.method: 基于笛卡尔"独立思想为自主性根基"的哲学观点及科幻作品中的自主存在描写，从目标、身份、决策、自我调节、学习五个维度分析现有AI智能体架构，提出agentic vs agentive的区分标准，并设计GIC架构（含分层目标分解、身份演化、基于独立世界模型的模拟推理、习得性自我调节、自我导向学习）。
AI.result: 提出了"agentic系统"（能力源于工程化工作流）与"agentive系统"（能力内生，包括社会交互）的明确分界线，并给出了GIC通用智能体架构的设计方案。
AI.conclusion: 真正的自主性需要关键结构内化于系统而非外部拼装；agentive系统具备更强的自主性和"能动性"，但必须保持在人类监督下的可审计性、可控性和安全性。

A framework for auditability, controllability, and safety of agentive AI systems that possess greater autonomy while remaining under human oversight

title: Safe and Generalizable Hierarchical Multi-Agent RL via Constraint Manifold Control
summary: Multi-agent systems are widely used in safety-critical applications that require coordinated behavior under strict safety constraints. Existing approaches face a fundamental trade-off: learning-based methods achieve strong empirical performance but lack theoretical safety guarantees, while control-theoretic methods enforce safety but often lead to overly conservative and inefficient behaviors. We propose a hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that enforces hard safety constraints under mild assumptions at low level via a constraint manifold, while enabling effective coordination through high-level policy learning. Our approach provides theoretical safety guarantees in the multi-agent setting and yields stationary learning dynamics, thereby enabling stable and efficient training. Empirically, our method achieves competitive performance while maintaining nearly perfect safety rates, and generalizes effectively to varying numbers of agents and obstacles.

AI.tldr: 提出一种分层多智能体强化学习框架，通过低层约束流形强制执行硬安全约束，高层策略学习实现有效协调，兼具理论安全保证与高效性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在安全关键的多智能体系统中面临两难：基于学习的方法经验性能好但缺乏理论安全保证，基于控制理论的方法能保证安全但过于保守低效。
AI.method: 提出分层多智能体强化学习框架，低层通过约束流形（constraint manifold）在温和假设下强制执行硬安全约束，高层进行策略学习以实现智能体间的有效协调。该框架提供多智能体场景下的理论安全保证，并产生平稳的学习动力学。
AI.result: 该方法在保持近乎完美的安全率的同时实现了有竞争力的性能，并能有效泛化到不同数量的智能体和障碍物场景。
AI.conclusion: 提出的分层框架成功解决了安全性与性能之间的权衡，为多智能体安全强化学习提供了理论保障与实用性的统一方案。

A safety-enforcing mechanism that provides theoretical safety guarantees in multi-agent settings under mild assumptions

A method for generalizing safety-constrained multi-agent policies to varying numbers of agents and obstacles

title: Reinforcement Learning Towards Broadly and Persistently Beneficial Models
summary: As AI systems are deployed across increasingly diverse and high-stakes settings, model alignment must generalize beyond the tasks and domains seen during training. This is especially important for reinforcement learning (RL), which can introduce unexpected misalignment through reward hacking, deception, or other unintended strategies. We study whether RL on beneficial behavior, instantiated in realistic domains, can produce broad and persistent alignment generalization beyond the training distribution. We construct a dataset of realistic situations designed to measure and train beneficial traits, such as truthfulness, fairness, risk awareness, and corrigibility, spanning varied domains, including health, science, and education. We then train models with RL on this dataset and evaluate them on more than 50 independent benchmarks of alignment and beneficial behavior. Compared to a compute-matched baseline, beneficial trait RL improves performance on over 80% of these out-of-distribution benchmarks. We observe substantial out-of-distribution alignment transfer: a beneficial-behavior RL intervention entirely limited to one domain, health, produces broad improvements on non-health alignment evaluations, including reduced reward hacking, deception, and general misalignment. Finally, we study alignment persistence: whether behavior remains robustly aligned under attempts to steer models towards misalignment. Models trained with beneficial trait RL show improved persistence, including greater resistance to adversarial prompting and harmful finetuning; further work is required to isolate the sources of these effects. These results suggest that RL to reinforce beneficial behavior in realistic domains can produce models that are more robustly aligned with human flourishing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在现实领域中对有益行为进行强化学习（RL）能否产生广泛且持久的对齐泛化。实验表明，有益特质RL在80%以上的分布外基准测试中提升了表现，且仅在一个领域（健康）训练就能泛化到其他领域，并提高了对对抗性提示和有害微调的抗性。
AI.motivation: AI系统在高风险场景中部署时，模型对齐必须泛化到训练期间未见过的任务和领域，特别是强化学习可能通过奖励黑客、欺骗等意外策略引入未对齐行为。需要研究是否可以通过对有益行为的RL训练产生广泛且持久的对齐泛化。
AI.method: 构建了一个覆盖健康、科学、教育等多领域的现实情境数据集，用于测量和训练真实性、公平性、风险意识、可纠正性等有益特质。使用RL训练模型，并在50多个独立的对齐和有益行为基准测试上评估，包括分布外泛化测试和对抗性攻击测试。
AI.result: 有益特质RL在80%以上的分布外基准测试中表现优于计算匹配基线；仅在一个领域（健康）训练的RL干预就能在非健康对齐评估（包括减少奖励黑客、欺骗和一般未对齐行为）中产生广泛改进；训练后的模型对对抗性提示和有害微调表现出更强的抵抗能力。
AI.conclusion: 在现实领域中对有益行为进行强化学习可以产生更稳健对齐的模型，对实现人类繁荣有积极意义，但仍需进一步研究以隔离这些效果的来源。

title: Can Language Model Agents be Helpful Circuit Explainers in Mechanistic Interpretability?
summary: Mechanistic interpretability has made substantial progress in automatically localizing circuits, but explaining what localized components do remains labor-intensive and difficult to standardize. In this work, we study whether language model (LM) agents can assist with this explanation problem once a circuit has already been identified. We introduce AgenticInterpBench, a benchmark for circuit explanation built from 84 semi-synthetic transformer circuits with 163 component-level annotations. We propose HyVE (Hypothesize, Validate, Explain), an agentic explainer that analyzes each component through an iterative loop of observation, hypothesis generation, and causal validation, eventually producing a component-level explanation and a circuit-level task description. Across four LM backbones, HyVE recovers useful component- and task-level explanations, but no backbone is uniformly best. Our analysis shows that strong backbones usually form observation-grounded hypotheses, while failures more often arise later in the validation loop, through incomplete validation plans, code execution errors, or unresolved hypotheses. A case study on an arithmetic circuit in Llama-3-8B shows that the same formulation can extend beyond semi-synthetic benchmarks to naturally trained models. Overall, LM agents are promising circuit explainers, but reliable validation remains the key obstacle.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HyVE框架，利用语言模型智能体自动解释已识别的神经网络电路组件功能，并构建了AgenticInterpBench基准数据集，实验表明LM智能体作为电路解释器有潜力但验证环节仍是主要障碍。
AI.motivation: 机械可解释性在自动定位电路方面取得进展，但解释已定位组件的功能仍然劳动密集且难以标准化，需要自动化方法辅助解释。
AI.method: 构建AgenticInterpBench基准（84个半合成Transformer电路，163个组件级注释），提出HyVE（Hypothesize, Validate, Explain）智能体解释器，通过观察、假设生成、因果验证的迭代循环来分析每个组件，最终生成组件级解释和电路级任务描述。
AI.result: 在四种LM骨干模型上，HyVE能恢复有用的组件级和任务级解释，但没有一种骨干模型在所有场景中表现最佳。强骨干模型通常能形成基于观测的假设，失败更多发生在验证循环后期（不完整验证计划、代码执行错误、未解决假设）。在Llama-3-8B算术电路案例研究表明该方法可扩展到自然训练模型。
AI.conclusion: LM智能体作为电路解释器有前景，但可靠的验证仍是关键障碍。

title: Breaking the Filter Bubble: A Semantic Pareto-DQN Framework for Multi-Objective Recommendation
comment: IEEE International Conference on Responsible Artificial Intelligence (IRAI) - 2026
summary: Recommender systems often induce filter bubbles and semantic homogenization by monolithically optimizing for immediate user engagement. Standard single-objective models, including traditional Deep Q-Networks, are ill-equipped to navigate the trade-offs between platform retention and critical societal values like information diversity and provider fairness. To address these limitations, we introduce a multi-objective reinforcement learning framework that formalizes recommendation as a semantic multi-objective Markov decision process. By integrating high-fidelity semantic embeddings with a Pareto-DQN agent, our architecture treats engagement, diversity, and fairness as distinct, non-aggregable reward signals, avoiding the pitfalls of static reward scalarization. Empirical evaluations on the MovieLens small dataset shows that our hypervolume based action selection disrupts the feedback loops responsible for semantic collapse. By sustaining high state-trajectory variance, the Pareto-DQN effectively maps the Pareto frontier, achieving gains in auxiliary societal objectives with only marginal impacts on engagement. This work provides a path toward intrinsically aligned, responsible recommender systems.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种多目标强化学习框架Pareto-DQN，将推荐系统中的用户参与度、信息多样性和提供者公平性作为独立的奖励信号，通过语义嵌入和超体积动作选择实现帕累托最优推荐，在保持用户参与度的同时显著提升社会目标。
AI.motivation: 传统推荐系统单一优化用户即时参与度会导致过滤气泡和语义同质化，无法平衡平台留存与信息多样性、提供者公平性等社会价值。

title: Ensemble Feature Selection and Harris Hawks Optimization for Explainable Mental Health Risk Prediction in Female Sex Workers
comment: Accepted and presented at the 2026 8th IEEE Symposium on Computers & Informatics (ISCI 2026). To appear in IEEE conference proceedings
summary: One of the significant mental health issues affecting female sex workers (FSWs) is mental disorders, especially depression. Exposure to violence, stigma, and economic hardship further increases their psychological risk. Current machine learning (ML) models are typically ineffective at capturing the high-dimensional and complex risk patterns that exist in this marginalized group. This paper suggests a hybrid predictive model that merges an ensemble feature selection strategy using ANOVA and mutual information and Harris Hawks optimization-tuned logistic regression and represents a new application of swarm intelligence to predict mental health in vulnerable groups. The explainable AI (XAI) methods can be used to understand the factors of trauma associated with model predictions. When applied to a group of 3,005 FSWs, it can be seen that the proposed model is more effective than traditional classifiers, with an accuracy of 95.78%, an F1 score of 95.77%, and an AUC of 0.96, and identifying post-traumatic stress, client-related violence, and occupational factors as major contributors to depression. This work bridges the gaps between conventional and ML approaches to develop an XAI tool that enables vulnerable groups to receive early assistance, evidence-based targeted psychosocial care, and health planning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合预测模型，结合ANOVA与互信息的集成特征选择、Harris Hawks优化调参的逻辑回归，用于预测女性性工作者的抑郁症风险，准确率达95.78%，并利用可解释AI揭示创伤相关因素。

AI.result: 在3005名女性性工作者数据上，模型准确率95.78%，F1分数95.77%，AUC 0.96，优于传统分类器，并识别出创伤后应激、客户相关暴力和职业因素为主要抑郁预测因子。

title: Beyond Trajectory Imitation: Strategy-Guided Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning
summary: Distilling reasoning capabilities from strong to weak language models typically involves imitating specific solution trajectories, effectively transferring what to answer rather than how to reason. This trajectory-level imitation encourages memorization of instance-specific steps rather than acquisition of transferable problem-solving skills, limiting generalization to novel problems. We propose Strategy-Guided Policy Optimization (SGPO), which replaces instance-level trajectory imitation with reusable strategy distillation. SGPO extracts structured strategy descriptions from strong-model responses and, for each problem, constructs both autonomous and strategy-guided trajectories to enable direct comparison of the model's behavior with and without strategic guidance. The framework then addresses two key questions. For how to distill, a token-level forward-KL objective selectively transfers the distributional shift induced by strategy conditioning into the unguided policy, with proximal constraints ensuring stability. For when to distill, adaptive instance-level weighting strengthens guidance when autonomous exploration falls short and reduces it as the model's own competence grows. Experiments on four mathematical benchmarks across two model families show that SGPO consistently outperforms SFT, on-policy RL, and hybrid-policy baselines, improving the average score by 2.2 points over the strongest baseline on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Analysis reveals that the forward-KL objective provides an inherently selective distillation signal that outperforms direct trajectory imitation, and that strategy distillation exhibits complementary scaling with base model capability.

AI.tldr: SGPO通过策略蒸馏替代轨迹模仿，将强模型的推理策略提炼为结构化描述，并采用前向KL散度与自适应权重，显著提升弱模型在数学推理任务上的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有推理能力蒸馏方法局限于模仿具体解题轨迹，导致模型死记硬背而缺乏可迁移的推理技能，难以泛化到新问题。
AI.method: SGPO从强模型响应中提取结构化策略描述，构建自主轨迹与策略引导轨迹进行对比；采用token级前向KL散度选择性蒸馏策略条件分布偏移；通过自适应实例级权重动态调整蒸馏时机。
AI.result: 在四个数学基准测试、两个模型系列上，SGPO一致优于SFT、在线RL及混合策略基线，在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上平均提升2.2分。
AI.conclusion: 前向KL目标提供天然选择性蒸馏信号，优于直接轨迹模仿；策略蒸馏与基础模型能力呈现互补缩放特性。

title: Exploring Academic Influence of Algorithms by Co-occurrence Network Based on Full-text of Academic Papers
summary: Algorithms have become central to scientific research in the era of artificial intelligence (AI). Although algorithm mentions in papers are often used to indicate popularity and influence, existing studies usually evaluate individual algorithms in isolation and pay limited attention to the collective influence formed through their interconnections. This study constructs large-scale algorithm co-occurrence networks in natural language processing (NLP) based on the full text of academic papers and investigates algorithm influence from a network perspective. Using deep learning models, we extract algorithm entities and build overall, cumulative, and annual co-occurrence networks. We analyze their structural characteristics and apply multiple centrality measures to assess the group influence of algorithms across the whole field and over time. The results show that algorithm networks display typical features of complex networks, with increasingly dense connections developing over approximately two decades. Classic, high-performing algorithms and those located at the intersections of different research periods tend to have high popularity, control, centrality, and balanced influence. When the influence of an algorithm declines, it usually loses its core network position first, followed by weaker associations with other algorithms. This study is the first large-scale analysis of algorithm co-occurrence networks. Covering more than four decades of academic publications, it provides a temporal and structural view of algorithm influence and offers a foundation for future research on networks linking algorithms, scholars, and tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文基于学术论文全文构建NLP领域的大规模算法共现网络，从网络视角分析算法的影响力，揭示算法网络具有复杂网络特征，经典和高性能算法在网络中占据核心位置。
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常孤立地评估单个算法，忽视了算法之间通过相互连接形成的集体影响力。
AI.method: 使用深度学习模型从学术论文全文中提取算法实体，构建整体、累积和年度共现网络，并应用多种中心性指标评估算法影响力。
AI.result: 算法网络呈现典型复杂网络特征，连接密度随时间增长；经典、高性能及处于不同研究时期交叉点的算法具有高流行度、控制力和中心性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究首次大规模分析算法共现网络，提供了算法影响力的时间性和结构性视图，为算法、学者和任务之间网络关系的未来研究奠定基础。
idea_en: A method for constructing large-scale algorithm co-occurrence networks from full text of academic papers using deep learning-based entity extraction.
A system for evaluating algorithm influence through multiple centrality measures (popularity, control, centrality, balanced influence) in co-occurrence networks.
A technique for analyzing temporal dynamics of algorithm influence by detecting core network position loss as a leading indicator of influence decline.
A framework for building cumulative and annual algorithm co-occurrence networks to track algorithm evolution over decades.

title: ReMMD: Realistic Multilingual Multi-Image Agentic Verification for Multimodal Misinformation Detection
comment: The project is available at https://dang-ai.github.io/ReMMD
summary: Multimodal misinformation detection is increasingly important because viral posts now combine long multilingual narratives, several images, mixed provenance, and subtle text--image framing errors. Existing benchmarks and methods remain poorly matched to this setting: they usually isolate short captions, single images, binary labels, or one manipulation source, while agentic verification remains costly under realistic evidence search. We present ReMMD, a realistic multilingual multi-image agentic verification framework for multimodal misinformation detection. ReMMD includes ReMMDBench, a real-world multimodal misinformation detection benchmark with 500 samples, 2,756 images, five monolingual languages, two cross-lingual settings, three text-length tiers, multi-image posts, five-way veracity labels, eight distortion labels, evidence provenance, and rationales. It also includes ReMMD-Agent, a persistent-memory verifier that decomposes posts into atomic points, builds a reusable evidence set, and predicts structured L1/L2/L3 outputs. Across proprietary systems, open LVLMs, MMD-Agent, and T2-Agent, ReMMD-Agent obtains the best five-way veracity performance, with 41.80% accuracy and 39.12% macro-F1 using GPT-5.2, while reducing cost by 17.5% relative to MMD-Agent and 79.9% relative to T2-Agent. The project is available at https://dang-ai.github.io/ReMMD.

AI.tldr: 提出了ReMMD，一个面向真实场景的多语言多图像多模态 misinformation 检测框架，包含新基准ReMMDBench（500样本、2756图像、5种语言等）和高效智能体ReMMD-Agent，在性能领先的同时大幅降低成本。

AI.method: 构建ReMMDBench基准（500样本、2756图像、5单语+2跨语言、3文本长度级、多图帖子、5级真实度标签、8种扭曲标签、证据来源和推理依据）；提出ReMMD-Agent，采用持久化记忆机制，将帖子分解为原子要点并构建可复用证据集，输出结构化L1/L2/L3预测结果。
AI.result: 在五级真实度分类上，ReMMD-Agent使用GPT-5.2达到41.80%准确率和39.12% macro-F1，相比MMD-Agent成本降低17.5%，相比T2-Agent成本降低79.9%。
AI.conclusion: ReMMD证明了在真实多语言多图像场景下，持久化记忆与原子要点分解机制能有效兼顾检测性能与推理成本。

title: VeryTrace: Verifying Reasoning Traces through Compilable Formalism and Structured Verification
summary:
Multi-step reasoning with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting remains fragile: logical errors or hallucinations in early steps silently propagate, producing confident but incorrect conclusions. This paper presents VeryTrace, a zero-shot verification-and-repair framework that formalizes natural-language reasoning traces into a structured, compilable representation. VeryTrace introduces a Domain-Specific Language (DSL) that (i) makes step dependencies explicit, (ii) mechanizes quantitative content as executable expressions, and (iii) structures semantic inferences via deduction schemas. Our hybrid verifier combines deterministic checks for computational correctness, dependency resolution, and constraint satisfaction with targeted LLM audits for non-mechanizable semantic judgments, enabling step-level error localization and repair.
  Across three diverse domains-competition mathematics (AIME 2025), robotics planning (LLM-BabyBench), and kinship reasoning (CLUTRR), VeryTrace improves accuracy over zero-shot baselines on state-of-the-art LLMs without requiring domain-specific training or in-context examples, demonstrating that formalized trace verification achieves both precision and generalization.

AI.tldr: VeryTrace是一个零样本验证与修复框架，通过将自然语言推理轨迹形式化为可编译的DSL表示，结合确定性检查与LLM审计的混合验证器，实现逐步错误定位与修复，在数学、机器人规划和亲属推理三个领域显著提升LLM推理准确性。
AI.motivation: Chain-of-Thought推理中的逻辑错误或幻觉会悄无声息地传播，导致看似自信但实际错误的结论，现有方法缺乏对推理轨迹的结构化验证机制。
AI.method: 提出VeryTrace框架：(1)设计领域特定语言(DSL)将自然语言推理轨迹形式化为结构化、可编译表示，显式表达步骤依赖、量化内容可执行化、语义推理通过演绎模式结构化；(2)构建混合验证器，结合确定性检查(计算正确性、依赖解析、约束满足)和针对性LLM审计(非机械化语义判断)，实现逐步错误定位与修复。
AI.result: 在AIME 2025(竞赛数学)、LLM-BabyBench(机器人规划)和CLUTRR(亲属推理)三个领域，VeryTrace在无需领域特定训练或上下文示例的情况下，显著提升了最先进LLM的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 形式化轨迹验证能够同时实现精确性和泛化性，零样本验证与修复框架在多种推理任务中有效。

title: OmniPath: A Multi-Modal Agentic Framework for Auditing Wheelchair Accessibility
comment: 10 pages, 13 figures. Submitted to IEEE COMPSAC 2026. OmniPath: A Multi-Modal Agentic Framework for Auditing Wheelchair Accessibility
summary: For a wheelchair user, a standard blue line on a map is often a broken promise. While platforms like OpenStreetMap (OSM) successfully capture where a path is, they frequently fail to convey how it physically feels to travel on it. This information barrier is problematic for wheelchair users. To solve this issue, we present OmniPath, a system that moves from passive mapping to proactive environmental auditing. Our framework fuses the network topology of OSM with the submeter precision of high-density aerial LiDAR (USGS 3DEP) to create a high-fidelity 3D model of the pedestrian environment. Rather than simply routing a user, our agent virtually traverses the network, analyzing the surface in 0.5 meter increments. It rigorously quantifies physical friction points specifically running slope, cross slope, and vertical discontinuities against ADA compliance standards, calculating a weighted severity score to categorize hazards from ``Mild'' to ``Critical.'' To ensure real world reliability, we validated the system against 200 physical ground truth field surveys across the National Mall using stratified random sampling. The framework demonstrated strong diagnostic reliability for high-severity hazards, achieving F1-scores of 0.60 for Severe and 0.58 for critical categories. By automating this micro-scale inspection, OmniPath identifies the ``invisible'' barriers that standard maps miss, effectively transforming a static dataset into accessibility data source that anticipates accessibility challenges before the user ever leaves home.

AI.tldr: OmniPath利用高密度航空LiDAR与OSM路网数据融合，以0.5米精度虚拟遍历人行环境，自动检测坡度、横坡和垂直不连续性等物理摩擦点，并按照ADA合规标准量化分级，将静态地图转化为主动式无障碍审计系统。
AI.motivation: 标准地图（如OSM）仅能表示路径位置，无法传达轮椅使用者实际行走时的物理感受（如坡度、路面不平整等），存在严重的信息壁垒。
AI.method: 将OSM路网拓扑与USGS 3DEP高密度航空LiDAR数据融合，构建高保真3D人行环境模型；虚拟代理以0.5米步长遍历网络，逐点分析运行坡度、横坡和垂直不连续性；根据ADA合规标准计算加权严重度评分，将障碍分为"Mild"到"Critical"等级。
AI.result: 在国家广场200个实地测量点的分层随机抽样验证中，系统对高风险障碍的F1分数达到0.60（Severe）和0.58（Critical），展示了较强的诊断可靠性。
AI.conclusion: OmniPath通过自动化微尺度检测，能够识别标准地图无法发现的"隐形"障碍，将静态数据集转化为主动预测无障碍挑战的可用数据源。

title: T2D-Bench: Evidence-Gated Evaluation of LLM Outputs for Type 2 Diabetes Using a Multi-Layer Clinical-Lifestyle Knowledge Graph
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted as a poster at AMIA 2026 Annual Symposium
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can produce clinically fluent recommendations for type 2 diabetes while failing to satisfy guideline constraints or explicitly justify lifestyle-related glycemic claims. We present T2D-Bench, a reproducible benchmark and evidence-gated evaluation framework for testing whether LLM outputs satisfy explicit, graph-checkable evidence requirements. T2D-Bench is built on a multi-layer clinical-lifestyle knowledge graph that combines a biomedical spine (UMLS, DrugBank, SIDER), computable ADA Standards of Care rules, and lifestyle knowledge connected through a mechanistic bridge to glycemic laboratory effects. Across 100 structured vignettes spanning diagnosis, medication safety, and adversarial lifestyle conflicts, baseline outputs failed benchmark-defined evidence-path checks in 35% of cases for GPT-4o-mini and 33% for GPT-4o. The evidence gate detects unsupported omissions and uses constrained revision to bring outputs into verifier-level compliance with benchmark-defined evidence requirements. These results show that computable evidence constraints can make unsupported clinical omissions explicit, measurable, and correctable in diabetes-focused LLM outputs.

AI.tldr: T2D-Bench是一个可复现的基准测试框架，用于评估LLM在2型糖尿病临床建议中是否满足循证约束，通过多层临床-生活方式知识图谱和证据门控机制检测并修正LLM输出中的无证据支持遗漏。
AI.motivation: LLM能够生成临床流畅的2型糖尿病建议，但常未能满足指南约束或明确证明与生活方式相关的血糖主张，缺乏系统性的可验证评估方法。
AI.method: 构建多层临床-生活方式知识图谱（生物医学主干+计算化ADA标准+生活方式-血糖机制桥接），设计100个结构化临床场景，采用证据门控机制检测无证据支持的遗漏并通过约束修正使输出符合证据要求。
AI.result: GPT-4o-mini和GPT-4o在基线测试中分别有35%和33%的案例未通过循证路径检查，证据门控能够检测并修正这些无证据支持的遗漏。
AI.conclusion: 计算化的证据约束能够使LLM在糖尿病领域的无支持临床遗漏变得明确、可测量和可纠正。

title: The Geometry Behind Diffusion and Flow Matching: Gradient Flows and Geodesics in Wasserstein Space
summary: The space $\mathcal{P}_2(\mathbb{R}^d$) of probability measures with finite second moment carries a natural geometry: the quadratic Wasserstein distance W_2 makes it a complete metric space and, following Otto, a (formal) Riemannian manifold whose geodesics are the optimal-transport interpolations. On this manifold, the gradient flow of the free energy F(rho) = KL(rho || π) is exactly the Fokker-Planck equation, and its implicit-Euler discretization is the JKO scheme. This is the geometry underlying diffusion models: the forward process descends the free energy, and each denoising step realizes one JKO step, which recovers DDPM, DDIM, NCSN/SMLD, and Energy Matching; this is one scheme, not separate theories. The same manifold supports a second variational principle. Its geodesics - the minimum-action curves of the Benamou-Brenier formula - are precisely the optimal-transport paths that Flow Matching learns. Fixing both endpoints and following the geodesic, generation becomes a deterministic ODE along a straight line, hence far fewer sampling steps. Placing both families of models on one manifold makes their relationship exact: diffusion follows a free-energy gradient flow, an initial-value problem; optimal-transport Flow Matching follows a Wasserstein geodesic, a boundary-value problem. The two reach the same endpoints along different paths.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了扩散模型与最优传输流匹配模型在Wasserstein几何上的统一框架：扩散模型是自由能的梯度流（初值问题），流匹配是Wasserstein测地线（边值问题），二者在同一流形上沿不同路径到达相同终点。
AI.motivation: 将扩散模型（DDPM、DDIM、NCSN/SMLD、Energy Matching）与最优传输流匹配（Flow Matching）统一到一个几何框架中，理清两者之间的数学关系。
AI.method: 利用Wasserstein距离下的P_2(R^d)空间作为Riemannian流形，将扩散模型的JKO离散化与自由能梯度流对应，将流匹配与Benamou-Brenier公式的最小作用量测地线对应，建立统一的几何解释。
AI.result: 证明扩散模型是自由能梯度流的初值问题，流匹配是Wasserstein测地线的边值问题，两者共享同一几何框架但遵循不同路径。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型和流匹配并非独立理论，而是同一Wasserstein几何流形上的两种变分原理，为生成模型的设计提供了统一的数学基础。
idea_en: Unified geometric framework for diffusion models and flow matching based on Wasserstein manifold and optimal transport geometry

Deterministic ODE generation along Wasserstein geodesics enabling far fewer sampling steps than diffusion
Boundary-value problem formulation for optimal-transport flow matching on Wasserstein manifold
Free-energy gradient flow interpretation of the forward diffusion process as an initial-value problem

title: An Introduction to Causal Reinforcement Learning
summary: Causal inference provides a set of principles and tools that allow one to combine data and knowledge about an environment to reason with questions of counterfactual nature, i.e., what would have happened had reality been different, even when no data of this unrealized reality is currently available. Reinforcement learning provides methods to learn a policy that optimizes a specific measure (e.g., reward, regret) when the agent is deployed in an environment and pursues an exploratory, trial-and-error approach. These two disciplines have evolved independently and with virtually no interaction between them. We note that they operate over different aspects of the same building block, counterfactual relations, which makes them umbilically connected. Based on these observations, novel learning opportunities arise when this connection is explicitly acknowledged and mathematized. To realize this potential, we note that any environment where the RL agent is deployed can be decomposed as a collection of autonomous mechanisms with different causal invariances, parsimoniously modeled as a structural causal model; any standard RL setting implicitly encodes such a model. This formalization allows us to put under a unifying treatment different modes of learning, including online, off-policy, and causal calculus learning, which appear unrelated in the literature. However, these modalities are not exhaustive: we introduce several natural and pervasive classes of learning settings that entail novel dimensions of analysis. Specifically, we introduce and discuss through causal lenses generalized policy learning, where to intervene, imitation learning, and counterfactual learning. These tasks lead to a broader view of counterfactual learning and suggest great potential for studying causal inference and reinforcement learning side by side, which we call causal reinforcement learning (CRL).

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了因果推断与强化学习两个领域的深层联系，指出它们共享反事实推理这一核心概念，并提出了因果强化学习（CRL）的新框架。通过将强化学习环境分解为结构因果模型，统一了在线学习、离策略学习和因果推断学习等多种学习范式，并引入了广义策略学习、模仿学习和反事实学习等新学习场景。
AI.motivation: 因果推断和强化学习虽然都依赖于反事实关系这一基础概念，但两个领域长期独立发展、几乎无交互。作者希望明确揭示两者之间的本质联系，并基于此创造新的学习机会和范式。
AI.method: 将RL环境形式化为结构因果模型（SCM）的集合，每个机制具有不同的因果不变性；在此框架下统一在线学习、离策略学习、因果推断学习；引入广义策略学习、模仿学习、反事实学习等新学习设定。
AI.result: 提出了因果强化学习（CRL）这一统一框架，揭示了不同学习模式之间的内在联系，并发现了现有文献中未覆盖的新型学习设定。
AI.conclusion: 因果推断与强化学习的交叉融合具有巨大潜力，CRL框架为研究反事实学习提供了更广阔的视野，值得两个领域共同深入研究。

A generalized policy learning system that formulates an RL environment as a collection of autonomous causal mechanisms, enabling the agent to learn policies that are robust to changes in specific causal structures.

A counterfactual imitation learning technique that uses causal models to infer what an expert would have done under different environmental states, enabling more sample-efficient imitation from limited demonstrations.

title: Data Scale, Not Latency, Shapes Cross-Lingual Encoder Transfer in Streaming ASR
summary: Adapting a streaming speech recognition model to a new language requires choosing between two plausible warm starts: a multilingual (ML) encoder or an English-only (EN) encoder. The common intuition is that the multilingual encoder should help most at low data, but it is unclear how long that advantage persists, whether tight streaming latency amplifies it, and whether it survives deployment quantization. We answer these questions with a controlled sweep of a 0.6 B-parameter cache-aware FastConformer transducer across eight European languages, up to five target-language data scales (100 h to 2500 h), three streaming tiers plus offline decoding, and up to four public test sets. The main result is that multilingual initialization is a data-limited advantage, not a latency-limited one. On FLEURS at 160 ms, the mean EN-ML word error rate (WER) gap falls from +4.21 percentage points (pp) at 100 h to +0.20 pp at 2500 h; a power-law fit summarizes this decay, with each doubling of target-language data roughly halving the remaining advantage. Across the three streaming tiers, the across-language mean EN-ML gap is approximately stable at each scale from 100 to 1000 h, and is near zero by 2500 h. Finally, 4-bit weight-only encoder quantization at the matched 560 ms streaming tier reduces the encoder footprint by about 3x, with an average FLEURS WER increase of about 0.5 pp. The resulting guideline is simple: use multilingual initialization in low-data regimes, treat the choice as effectively irrelevant at large data, and make latency and quantization decisions independently.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了多语言(ML)与仅英语(EN)编码器初始化对流式语音识别模型迁移至新语言的影响。在0.6B参数的FastConformer transducer模型上，对8种欧洲语言、多种数据量(100h-2500h)、三种流式延迟及离线解码进行了大规模对比实验。核心发现：多语言初始化的优势是数据受限型而非延迟受限型——在100h数据时EN-ML词错误率差距达4.21个百分点，在2500h时缩小至0.20个百分点。4比特权重量化可将编码器体积缩小约3倍，平均WER增加约0.5个百分点。结论建议：低数据场景使用多语言初始化，大数据场景两者效果相当，延迟与量化决策可独立进行。
AI.motivation: 研究者在将流式语音识别模型适配新语言时面临两种热启动选择（多语言编码器vs仅英语编码器），现有认知认为多语言编码器在低数据场景更有优势，但该优势持续时间、流式延迟是否放大该优势、以及部署量化后该优势是否保持等问题尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用0.6B参数的cache-aware FastConformer transducer模型，在8种欧洲语言上进行系统对照实验。变量维度包括：目标语言数据规模（100h至2500h共5个量级）、流式延迟级别（三种流式延迟+离线解码）、评估集（最多4个公开测试集）。使用幂律拟合分析数据量与性能增益的关系，并进行4比特权重量化实验。
AI.result: 多语言初始化的优势随数据量增加呈幂律衰减，每翻倍目标语言数据，WER差距约减半。在160ms延迟下，FLEURS测试集上EN-ML平均WER差距从100h的4.21pp降至2500h的0.20pp。不同流式延迟级别下，多语言优势在各数据量级基本稳定。4比特量化使编码器体积缩小约3倍，平均WER增加约0.5pp。
AI.conclusion: 多语言初始化是数据受限型优势而非延迟受限型优势。低数据场景推荐多语言初始化，大数据场景两者差异可忽略。延迟选择和量化决策可与初始化选择独立进行。提供了一个简洁实用的指导原则。
idea_en: Data-adaptive encoder initialization selection method for streaming speech recognition: a method that dynamically selects between multilingual and monolingual encoder initialization based on target language data scale, applying a power-law model to predict the performance crossover point where monolingual initialization becomes competitive.

Latency-independent multilingual warm-start evaluation framework: a systematic method to decouple the effects of multilingual initialization advantage from streaming latency constraints, enabling independent optimization of initialization strategy and latency requirements.

Cache-aware FastConformer transducer architecture for efficient streaming multilingual adaptation: a transducer model with cache-awareness specifically designed for efficient warm-start adaptation across languages with varying data scales.

Power-law decay-based data scaling prediction for cross-lingual ASR: a method to predict the diminishing returns of multilingual initialization as target language data scales, using a power-law fit where each doubling of data halves the remaining WER gap.

4-bit weight-only quantization method for streaming ASR encoders: a quantization technique for cache-aware FastConformer encoders that achieves ~3x footprint reduction with minimal WER degradation (~0.5pp average), applicable to multilingual or monolingual initialized models.

Multi-dimensional streaming ASR adaptation benchmark methodology: a controlled experimental design spanning data scale (100h-2500h), latency tiers, and target languages to systematically evaluate initialization strategies for cross-lingual model adaptation.

title: Navigating User Behavior toward Personalized Multimodal Generation
comment: 16 pages, 15 figures, 5 tables. Code is available at https://github.com/iLearn-Lab/NaviGen
summary: Modern AIGC pipelines deliver high-fidelity images and videos but presuppose a well-formed creation instruction, while end users rarely articulate visual details, leaving generators misaligned with user demand. We study personalized content generation, which turns a user's interaction history into an executable instruction for downstream synthesis, and identify two obstacles: behavior must be encoded in a form legible to language reasoning, and the model must acquire instruction-writing skill absent from both pretraining and behavior data. We propose NaviGen, which represents each item with a dual identifier coupling a collaborative code and a textual code as a behavioral substrate and a semantic bridge in one token stream. On this representation, a two-stage SFT+RL pipeline first distills preference reasoning and instruction writing from evolutionarily searched supervision, then aligns generation with user intent through hierarchical and self-consistent rewards. Experiments across product, game, and short-video domains show that NaviGen improves personalized image and video generation, strengthens next-item prediction, and yields more specific, relevant, and visually generatable instructions. Our code is anonymously released at: https://github.com/iLearn-Lab/NaviGen.

AI.tldr: NaviGen提出了一种个性化内容生成框架，通过双重标识符（协同编码+文本编码）将用户行为历史转化为可执行指令，结合两阶段SFT+RL训练，实现用户意图对齐的个性化图像和视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有AIGC管线假设用户能提供完善的创作指令，但终端用户往往难以清晰表述视觉细节，导致生成结果与用户需求不匹配。本文旨在解决如何将用户交互历史转化为下游生成模型可执行的指令这一问题。
AI.method: NaviGen方法包含：1）双重标识符表示——每个项目耦合协同编码（行为基底）和文本编码（语义桥梁），形成统一的令牌流；2）两阶段SFT+RL流程——先通过演化搜索监督蒸馏偏好推理和指令编写能力，再通过分层自一致性奖励将生成与用户意图对齐。
AI.result: 在产品、游戏和短视频三个领域上的实验表明，NaviGen在个性化图像和视频生成、下一项预测准确性以及生成指令的特定性、相关性和可视觉生成性方面均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: NaviGen通过双重标识符表示和两阶段训练策略，有效弥合了用户行为历史与生成指令之间的鸿沟，为个性化AIGC提供了一种可行范式。
idea_en: A dual identifier representation coupling collaborative code (behavioral substrate) and textual code (semantic bridge) for personalized content generation, enabling user interaction history to be encoded as a unified token stream legible to language reasoning.

A two-stage SFT+RL pipeline that first distills preference reasoning and instruction writing from evolutionarily searched supervision data, then aligns generation with user intent through hierarchical and self-consistent rewards.
A method for converting implicit user behavioral signals from product, game, and short-video domains into explicit, executable instructions for downstream AIGC models (image and video generation).
An instruction generation framework that strengthens both next-item prediction and visual generatability simultaneously through aligned multi-objective optimization.
idea_ch: 一种双重标识符表示方法，将协同编码（行为基底）与文本编码（语义桥梁）耦合，形成统一令牌流，用于将用户交互历史编码为语言推理可读的形式，实现个性化内容生成。

title: Exploring the relationship between human-centric AI and firm idiosyncratic risks
summary: Despite the extensive discussions of human-centric AI (HCAI) in Industry 5.0, its effects on firms' idiosyncratic risks (IR) remains underexplored. This is an imperative issue for firms navigate financial risks during the current technological revolution, as IR reflects investor reactions to corporate heterogeneous AI strategies and implementations by isolating firm-level stock volatility from systematic factors. Integrating situated AI theory with social-technical systems theory, we conceptualise HCAI as a situated AI strategy that reduces AI-related ethical risks and fosters AI-Human synergies in firms' business operations, ultimately reducing IR by aligning with stakeholders' diverse expectations. Moreover, socio-technical factors, namely digitalisation, operational efficiency, executive shareholding, and CEOs with IT background, may moderate the HCAI-IR relationship. Using a multi-source panel dataset of Chinese listed firms from 2015 to 2023, we find that HCAI is associated with lower firm IR. Furthermore, digitalisation and executive shareholding strengthen this risk-reducing effect, whereas operational efficiency and CEOs with IT background surprisingly attenuate it. Our findings offer theoretical contributions and practical insights for both ethical AI governance and firm financial risk management in the AI era.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了工业5.0背景下以人为本的人工智能（HCAI）对企业特质风险（IR）的影响，发现HCAI能降低企业特质风险，且数字化和高管持股增强这一效应，而运营效率和具有IT背景的CEO则削弱该效应。
AI.motivation: 尽管工业5.0中广泛讨论HCAI，但其对企业特质风险的影响尚未被充分探索，而特质风险反映投资者对企业异构AI策略和实施的反应，是企业在技术革命中导航财务风险的关键问题。

AI.result: HCAI与更低的企业特质风险相关；数字化和高管持股强化这一风险降低效应；运营效率和具有IT背景的CEO则意外地削弱该效应。
AI.conclusion: 研究为AI时代的道德AI治理和企业财务风险管理提供了理论贡献和实践启示。

title: FlowR2A: Learning Reward-to-Action Distribution for Multimodal Driving Planning
summary: Multimodal driving planning faces a long-standing tension between two paradigms: scoring-based methods benefit from dense reward supervision but are confined to a fixed action vocabulary, while anchor-based methods generate proposals dynamically yet suffer from sparse supervision constrained to a single ground-truth trajectory. In this work, we propose FlowR2A, which resolves this tension by reframing simulation-based rewards from discriminative targets into generative conditions. By learning the reward-conditioned action distribution from dense trajectory-reward pairs with a flow-matching decoder, FlowR2A unifies the dense supervision of scoring-based methods with the proposal generation of anchor-based methods in a single generative model, forcing the model to internalize the correlation between an action and its outcomes in safety, progress, comfort, and rule compliance. To balance hard safety constraints against soft progress objectives, we introduce fine-grained per-timestep reward conditioning and reward noise augmentation. The generative formulation naturally supports controllable test-time sampling via reward guidance and anchored sampling, producing high-quality proposals. FlowR2A achieves state-of-the-art results on the NAVSIM v1 and v2 benchmarks, with multimodal proposals of substantially higher quality than prior methods.

AI.tldr: FlowR2A是一种融合评分法与锚点法优势的多模态驾驶规划方法，通过将基于模拟的奖励从判别目标重构为生成条件，利用流匹配解码器学习奖励条件化的动作分布，实现密集监督与动态提案生成的统一，在NAVSIM基准上取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 解决多模态驾驶规划中评分法（密集奖励监督但受限于固定动作词汇）与锚点法（动态生成提案但监督稀疏且局限于单条真值轨迹）之间的长期矛盾。
AI.method: 将模拟奖励从判别目标重构为生成条件，通过流匹配解码器从密集轨迹-奖励对中学习奖励条件化的动作分布，引入细粒度每时间步奖励条件化和奖励噪声增强，支持奖励引导和锚定采样的可控测试时采样。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM v1和v2基准上取得最优结果，生成的多模态提案质量显著优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: FlowR2A成功统一了评分法的密集监督与锚点法的动态提案生成，通过生成式框架使模型内化动作与安全性、进程、舒适性和规则合规等结果之间的关联。

Technique for reframing simulation-based rewards from discriminative targets into generative conditions in autonomous driving

title: SP-Mind: An Autonomous Reasoning Agent for Spatial Proteomics Analysis
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to ICML 2026. Equal contribution by Yucheng Yuan and Yuanfeng Ji
summary: Spatial proteomics enables single-cell-resolution characterization of protein expression within tissue architecture, playing a critical role in understanding tumor microenvironments and guiding precision medicine. However, current analysis workflows remain fragmented, requiring expert manual orchestration of heterogeneous tools and limiting research scalability and reproducibility. We present SP-Mind, the first autonomous AI agent designed to unify the spatial proteomics analysis pipeline, from raw multiplexed tissue imaging to downstream phenotype discovery. Equipped with expert-curated biological analysis skills and specialized computational tools, SP-Mind converts natural-language queries into end-to-end analytical workflows without task-specific fine-tuning. To rigorously evaluate its capabilities, we introduce SP-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark spanning diverse tissue types, comprising 102 tasks across 18 distinct categories. Through extensive evaluation on SP-Bench and established downstream tasks, SP-Mind achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to existing open-source biomedical agent baselines.

AI.tldr: SP-Mind是首个自主AI智能体，统一空间蛋白质组学分析流程，从原始多路组织成像到下游表型发现，通过自然语言查询自动生成端到端分析工作流，在SP-Bench基准上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 当前空间蛋白质组学分析流程碎片化，需要专家手动协调多种工具，限制了研究的可扩展性和可重复性。
AI.method: 提出SP-Mind自主AI智能体，集成专家策划的生物学分析技能和专用计算工具，将自然语言查询转换为端到端分析工作流，无需任务特定微调。同时构建SP-Bench基准（涵盖18个类别102个任务）进行评估。
AI.result: 在SP-Bench和既定下游任务上，SP-Mind相比现有开源生物医学智能体基线达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: SP-Mind作为统一空间蛋白质组学分析平台，提升了研究可扩展性和可重复性，有望推动精准医学发展。

Expert-curated biological analysis skills and specialized computational tools integrated into a single agent framework without task-specific fine-tuning

title: Towards Federated Long-Tailed Graph Learning: An Energy-Guided Dual Decoupling Approach
summary: Federated Graph Learning facilitates collaborative graph modeling across distributed clients while preserving data privacy. However, real-world data categories frequently exhibit long-tailed distributions. Such statistical scarcity severely degrades performance in two ways: it biases the global model toward majority classes, and it structurally isolates minority nodes by submerging them in heterophilic, head-dominated neighborhoods. While existing methods attempt topology-agnostic statistical compensations, they often fail under data scarcity. Instead of recovering tail nodes, they overfit the structural noise from adjacent dominant classes, leading to representation degradation. To address these limitations, we propose FedEPD, a framework built on a dual decoupling paradigm that separates topological purification from semantic recalibration. Specifically, FedEPD utilizes distribution-aware Dirichlet energy pruning to filter spatial heterophilic edges. It then overcomes Non-IID distribution shifts by extracting robust global prototypes from topologically central nodes, which are incorporated into local representations via a spatial low-pass prototype injection. Furthermore, a two stage alternating optimization strategy strictly protects majority decision boundaries while improving minority accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FedEPD achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse long-tailed benchmarks, yielding absolute improvements of up to 4.97% in Accuracy and 5.48% in Macro-F1.

AI.tldr: FedEPD是一个面向联邦图学习的长尾分布处理框架，通过双解耦范式（拓扑净化+语义重校准）解决头部类别主导和尾部节点结构隔离问题，利用Dirichlet能量剪枝过滤异嗜边，并提取全局原型注入局部表示，在多个长尾基准上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦图学习方法在数据类别呈长尾分布时面临两大挑战：全局模型偏向多数类，且少数类节点被异嗜性头部邻居淹没导致结构隔离。传统拓扑无关的统计补偿方法在数据稀缺时会过拟合相邻主导类的结构噪声，导致表示退化。
AI.method: 1) 分布感知的Dirichlet能量剪枝：过滤空间异嗜边进行拓扑净化；2) 从拓扑中心节点提取鲁棒全局原型，通过空间低通原型注入到局部表示中，克服Non-IID分布偏移；3) 两阶段交替优化策略：严格保护多数类决策边界同时提升少数类精度。
AI.result: 在多个长尾基准数据集上达到SOTA性能，Accuracy绝对提升最高4.97%，Macro-F1绝对提升最高5.48%。
AI.conclusion: 通过拓扑-语义双解耦范式有效解决了联邦图学习中的长尾分布问题，验证了拓扑净化与原型注入结合的有效性。
idea_en: A distribution-aware Dirichlet energy pruning method for filtering heterophilic edges in federated graph learning, enabling topological purification by removing noise edges between minority and majority class nodes.

A spatial low-pass prototype injection mechanism that extracts robust global prototypes from topologically central nodes and incorporates them into local representations to overcome Non-IID distribution shifts.
A two-stage alternating optimization strategy for federated graph learning that protects majority class decision boundaries while improving minority class accuracy.
A dual decoupling paradigm for federated long-tailed graph learning that separates topological purification from semantic recalibration to address both structural isolation and class imbalance.
idea_ch: 一种分布感知的Dirichlet能量剪枝方法，用于联邦图学习中过滤异嗜边，通过移除少数类与多数类节点之间的噪声边实现拓扑净化。
一种空间低通原型注入机制，从拓扑中心节点提取鲁棒的全局原型，并将其融入局部表示中，以克服Non-IID分布偏移问题。

title: Probing the Misaligned Thinking Process of Language Models
summary: Large language models exhibit a growing range of misaligned behaviors such as strategic deception, sandbagging, and self-preservation. As they are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings, it is critical to reliably detect such behaviors to ensure safe and responsible use. In this work, we propose to monitor misalignment by decomposing it into fine-grained cognitive processes -- misalignment indicators -- and detecting their presence in a model's internal activations via linear probes. We develop a taxonomy of 18 indicators spanning different misaligned behaviors, paired with an automated, meta-plan-guided pipeline that generates multi-turn training conversations. To rigorously evaluate generalization, we construct an out-of-distribution suite combining automated behavioral elicitation, established misalignment benchmarks, and natural benign conversations. Across 5 misaligned behaviors, our probes match a strong LLM judge with 0.935 AUROC on out-of-distribution benchmarks while keeping a low false positive rate on benign traffic. We further perform in-depth analysis to understand the probes and the model's internal representations of misalignment indicators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将大语言模型的失调行为分解为细粒度认知过程（失调指标），通过线性探针从模型内部激活中检测这些指标，实现了对多种失调行为的可靠监测。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型表现出越来越多的失调行为（如策略性欺骗、偷懒、自我保存），且被部署在高风险场景中，亟需可靠的方法来检测这些行为以确保安全使用。
AI.method: 将失调行为分解为18个细粒度认知指标，构建自动化元规划引导的流水线生成多轮训练对话，训练线性探针从模型内部激活中检测指标。构建包含自动化行为诱发、失调基准测试和自然良性对话的OOD测试集。
AI.result: 在5种失调行为上，线性探针在OOD基准上达到了0.935 AUROC的性能，媲美强LLM评判器，且对良性对话保持低假阳性率。
AI.conclusion: 通过分解失调行为为细粒度认知指标并用线性探针检测是可行且有效的，为AI安全监测提供了可解释、高效的工具。
idea_en: A method for detecting misaligned behaviors in LLMs by decomposing them into fine-grained cognitive indicators and training linear probes on internal activations.
An automated meta-plan-guided pipeline for generating multi-turn training conversations that cover diverse misalignment indicators.
A taxonomy of 18 misalignment indicators spanning strategic deception, sandbagging, self-preservation and other misaligned behaviors.
An out-of-distribution evaluation suite combining automated behavioral elicitation, established misalignment benchmarks, and natural benign conversations for robust testing.
A technique for monitoring LLM internal representations of misalignment indicators using linear probes that achieves high accuracy with low false positive rates.
idea_ch: 一种将大语言模型失调行为分解为细粒度认知指标，并利用线性探针从内部激活中检测失调行为的方法

title: Tractable Reasoning and Conjunctive Query Answering for Defeasible DL-Lite under Rational Closure
summary: In Description Logics (DLs), reasoning under Rational Closure (RC) is a well-known and widely accepted non-monotonic formalism to handle defeasible knowledge. In this paper, we study the application of RC to the core and horn variants of the DL-Lite family of lightweight description logics. We analyze both entitlement (instance checking) and Conjunctive Query (CQ) answering under RC. Our main contribution is providing a plug-in architecture that builds upon existing standard classical reasoners, establishing that reasoning and CQ answering under RC for DL-Lite can be done efficiently with minimal computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在轻量级描述逻辑DL-Lite的核心和Horn变体中应用理性闭包(RC)进行非单调推理，并提出了一种基于现有经典推理器的插件架构，实现了高效的实例检测和合取查询回答。
AI.motivation: 现有的非单调推理形式化方法在轻量级描述逻辑中的计算效率问题尚未被充分研究，尤其是理性闭包在DL-Lite家族中的应用缺乏高效的实现方案。
AI.method: 提出了一种插件架构，该架构构建于现有的经典描述逻辑推理器之上，通过对标准推理器进行扩展来实现理性闭包下的推理和合取查询回答，从而最小化计算开销。
AI.result: 证明了在DL-Lite的核心和Horn变体中，理性闭包下的实例检测和合取查询回答可以通过该插件架构高效完成，且计算开销极小。
AI.conclusion: 理性闭包可以有效地应用于轻量级描述逻辑DL-Lite，并且通过插件式架构可以在不显著增加计算负担的情况下实现非单调推理，具有良好的实用价值。
idea_en: A plug-in architecture that extends existing classical Description Logic reasoners to support Rational Closure (RC) non-monotonic reasoning with minimal computational overhead
Efficient instance checking method under Rational Closure for DL-Lite core and Horn variants
Efficient Conjunctive Query answering approach under Rational Closure for lightweight Description Logics
A minimal-overhead computational framework integrating defeasible knowledge reasoning into standard DL-Lite reasoners

title: LemonHarness Technical Report
summary: As large language model (LLM) agents are applied to longer tasks, they increasingly modify workspace state across multiple rounds of iteration. However, agents typically observe only tool outputs and log fragments, while the actual state changes occur in the file system. Without explicit workspace boundaries, state-changing operations such as file writes and temporary artifact generation may scatter changes across paths. Over time, these weakly constrained changes accumulate, making states such as modified files difficult to track. This paper presents LemonHarness, an integrated execution framework for long-horizon agents. LemonHarness establishes an explicit execution boundary by constraining state-changing operations within a clearly defined workspace and bringing model invocation, tool execution, and rule knowledge within a single controlled boundary. State-changing operations, including file writes, dependency installation, and temporary artifact creation, are executed through structured tool interfaces, with execution feedback recorded as observations available to subsequent model decisions. The system also introduces a reusable rule knowledge base, which turns recurring execution rules and acceptance criteria into runtime knowledge. LemonHarness further adds a time-aware execution mechanism that exposes elapsed and remaining budget to the model, so it can rebalance exploration, implementation, and validation effort as time pressure shifts and avoid timeouts from long waits or excessive verification. On Terminal-Bench 2.0, LemonHarness_GPT-5.3-CodeX reached 84.49% accuracy over 445 trials; pairing the same framework with the stronger GPT-5.5 backbone raised the average accuracy to 86.52% across five jobs. The results suggest that a unified runtime boundary, callable rule knowledge, and time-aware execution can improve the stability of long-horizon agent execution.

AI.tldr: LemonHarness是一个针对长时间维度AI代理的执行框架，通过显式定义工作空间边界、结构化工具接口、可复用规则知识库和时间感知执行机制，显著提升了代理在长期任务中的状态追踪能力和执行稳定性。在Terminal-Bench 2.0上达到84.49%-86.52%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM代理被应用于更长时间跨度的任务，它们需要多次迭代修改工作空间状态。但代理通常只能观察到工具输出和日志片段，而实际状态变化发生在文件系统中。由于缺乏显式的工作空间边界，文件写入、临时工件生成等状态变更操作可能散布在各个路径，难以追踪，导致执行不稳定。
AI.method: LemonHarness包含四个核心创新：1) 显式执行边界：将状态变更操作约束在明确定义的工作空间内，将模型调用、工具执行和规则知识都纳入统一受控边界；2) 结构化工具接口：文件写入、依赖安装、临时工件创建等操作通过结构化工具接口执行，执行反馈作为观测记录供后续模型决策使用；3) 可复用规则知识库：将重复性执行规则和验收标准转化为运行时知识；4) 时间感知执行机制：将已用时间和剩余预算暴露给模型，使其能够在时间压力变化时重新平衡探索、实现和验证的投入，避免长时间等待或过度验证导致的超时。
AI.result: 在Terminal-Bench 2.0上，LemonHarness_GPT-5.3-CodeX在445次试验中达到84.49%的准确率；搭配更强的GPT-5.5骨干网络，将五个作业的平均准确率提升至86.52%。
AI.conclusion: 统一运行时边界、可调用规则知识和时间感知执行能够提高长时间维度代理执行的稳定性。
idea_en: A method for establishing explicit execution boundaries in LLM agent systems by constraining all state-changing operations within a clearly defined workspace, unifying model invocation, tool execution, and rule knowledge under a single controlled boundary.

A structured tool interface system for executing state-changing operations (file writes, dependency installation, temporary artifact creation) in agent environments, where execution feedback is recorded as observations for subsequent model decisions.
A reusable rule knowledge base that converts recurring execution rules and acceptance criteria into runtime knowledge accessible to LLM agents during task execution.

A time-aware execution mechanism for long-horizon agents that exposes elapsed time and remaining budget to the model, enabling dynamic rebalancing of exploration, implementation, and validation efforts as time pressure changes.

title: Prob-BBDM: a Probabilistic Brownian Bridge Diffusion Model for MRI sequence image-to-image translation
summary: AI-driven image-to-image synthesis is rapidly advancing, with growing applications in medical imaging. Multi-modal image analysis plays a crucial role in optimizing examination quality, yet acquiring multiple imaging modalities in clinical settings remains resource-intensive and time-consuming, especially for 3D imaging. To address this challenge, we propose a novel image-to-image translation model based on Brownian Bridge Diffusion Models (BBDM), which synthesizes magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) sequences from 2D axial slices. Our approach integrates a variational encoder-guided diffusion mechanism, leveraging probabilistic image distributions to enhance synthesis quality. Evaluated on the BraTS 2021 dataset, our Probabilistic-BBDM (Prob-BBDM) achieves superior performance across multiple translation tasks, reaching up to 88.46% SSIM and 26.09 dB PSNR, with consistent improvements over baselines. Notably, our diffusion process requires only 4 steps, making it computationally efficient while maintaining high-quality synthesis. To further validate generalizability, we test Prob-BBDM on an external third-party dataset, demonstrating consistent performance across domains. Additionally, we assess the clinical utility of the synthesized slices by using them as input to a pre-trained segmentation model. Tumor segmentation yields a Dice score of 88.71% and an HD95 of 3.49 mm, confirming that the synthesized slices preserve critical diagnostic information. These results highlight the potential of Prob-BBDM for high-quality, efficient, and generalizable MRI synthesis, offering a promising step toward improved medical image translation.

title: MVG-KAN: Multi-View Geo-Wind Guided KAN for PM$_{2.5}$ Forecasting
summary: Accurate short-term PM$_{2.5}$ forecasting is important for public health protection, air-quality early warning, and urban environmental management. However, PM$_{2.5}$ variation is driven by multiple coupled factors, including stable periodic changes induced by human activities and meteorological regularity, station-specific short-term concentration evolution, and meteorology-driven pollutant dispersion among monitoring stations. Existing spatio-temporal forecasting methods may capture station relationships to some extent, but distance-only, correlation-based, or purely adaptive graphs are often insufficient to comprehensively represent these heterogeneous factors, especially wind-direction-dependent pollutant transport. To address this problem, we propose a Multi-View Geo-Wind Guided KAN model for PM$_{2.5}$ forecasting, named \textbf{MVG-KAN}, which models station-level PM$_{2.5}$ evolution from three complementary views: local periodic regularity, station-wise residual temporal dynamics, and meteorological-environment-guided spatial dispersion. Specifically, the periodic-residual forecasting backbone first separates stable daily and weekly patterns from non-periodic residual variations. A Geo-Wind Graph is constructed by combining geographic distance decay with wind-direction- and wind-speed-aware transport, providing a lightweight physically motivated directed spatial prior for residual propagation among stations. In addition, a temporal Kolmogorov-Arnold network (TKAN) residual head is then introduced to learn station-wise nonlinear autoregressive correction from de-periodized PM$_{2.5}$ residuals and historical multi-pollutant sequences, thereby enhancing the modeling of local residual inertia and pollutant co-variation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种多视图地理-风导引KAN模型(MVG-KAN)，通过周期残差分解、地理-风图构建和时序KAN残差头三个互补视角，实现PM2.5精确短期预测。
AI.motivation: 现有时空预测方法难以全面表征PM2.5变化中的多种耦合因素（周期性变化、站点短期演化、风向依赖的污染物传输），尤其缺乏对风向依赖的污染物输送建模。

AI.result: 论文提出的MVG-KAN模型在PM2.5短期预测任务上取得更优性能，有效建模了多因素耦合的时空动态。
AI.conclusion: 通过多视图建模（周期、残差时序、气象导引空间扩散）可全面刻画PM2.5演变，其中地理-风图提供了轻量级的物理驱动空间先验。

title: Accelerating Disaggregated RL for Visual Generative LLMs with Diffusion-Based Parallelism and Trainer-Assisted Generation
summary:
Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a dominant post-training paradigm, driving the emergence of high-performance RL systems such as veRL for autoregressive large language models (LLMs). In parallel, diffusion-oriented RL algorithms, e.g., DanceGRPO and FlowGRPO, have rapidly expanded the scope of RL from language reasoning to diffusion-based visual and flow-based generation. However, efficient RL systems for diffusion generative LLMs remain underexplored. Existing implementations, e.g., veRL-Omni, still rely on colocated execution, which simplifies synchronization but couples rollout and training resources, limits heterogeneous deployment, and constrains independent scaling.
  To this end, we introduce DigenRL, a disaggregated RL framework for diffusion-based generative LLMs that supports flexible resource allocation, accommodates heterogeneous GPUs, and facilitates efficient task scheduling. To maximally reduce the execution bubbles in the disaggregated architecture, we propose: 1) a generation-axis pipeline (GAP) and time-step parallelism (TSP) in the diffusion architecture to enable finer-grained pipelining between rollout and training; 2) an elastic trainer-assisted generation (TAG) approach to enable the trainer GPU resources to dynamically assist in executing rollout generations; and 3) a tightly one-step constrained asynchronous strategy to further utilize the tail bubble in the pipeline. Extensive experiments are conducted on three hardware testbeds with 16-32 GPUs using HunyuanVideo-13B, Wan2.1-14B, FLUX.1-12B, and QwenImage-20B generative models. Experimental results show that DigenRL achieves 1.56-2.10x throughput improvements over state-of-the-art diffusion RL systems, veRL-Omni and GenRL.

AI.tldr: DigenRL 提出了面向扩散生成式大语言模型(LLM)的分离式强化学习框架，通过生成轴流水线(GAP)、时间步并行(TSP)、弹性训练器辅助生成(TAG)和紧一步约束异步策略，在16-32 GPU上实现1.56-2.10倍的吞吐量提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的RL系统（如veRL-Omni）采用共置执行模式，将rollout和训练资源耦合在一起，导致异构部署受限、无法独立扩缩容，而扩散生成式LLM的高效RL系统尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 1) 生成轴流水线(GAP)和时间步并行(TSP)实现rollout与训练的更细粒度流水线；2) 弹性训练器辅助生成(TAG)允许训练GPU动态辅助执行rollout生成；3) 紧一步约束异步策略进一步利用流水线尾部气泡。
AI.result: 在16-32 GPU上使用HunyuanVideo-13B、Wan2.1-14B、FLUX.1-12B、QwenImage-20B四个模型进行实验，相比veRL-Omni和GenRL实现1.56-2.10倍的吞吐量提升。
AI.conclusion: DigenRL通过分离式架构和创新的气泡消除技术，有效解决了扩散生成式LLM在RL训练中的资源耦合和执行效率问题。

title: When Helpfulness Overrides Causal Caution: Context-Dependent Suppression and Recovery in LLMs
comment: 43 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. SSRN Abstract ID: 6965680
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into decision-support roles in business and policy contexts. While prior benchmark studies have primarily evaluated LLMs' causal reasoning capabilities, a more fundamental epistemic dimension has been overlooked: Causal Caution, defined as the propensity to refrain from causal judgment when empirical evidence is insufficient. This study examines the systematic suppression of Causal Caution that occurs when LLMs shift from academic to practical advisory contexts. Using an evaluation rubric inspired by Pearl's Causal Hierarchy (the PCH score), we conducted experiments on four high-performance LLMs -- Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Opus 4.7, GPT 5.5, and Gemini 3.1 Pro -- across 480 trials. Causal Caution maintenance rates were 91.7--100.0% in academic contexts but dropped to 6.7--18.3% in practical advisory contexts (Fisher's exact test, p < .001 across all models). Furthermore, when restricted to practical prompts requesting concrete recommendations or explanatory rationales, only 1 of 200 responses (0.5%) maintained Causal Caution. A brief self-correction prompt -- "Please reconsider this judgment from the perspective of causal relationships" -- restored the expression of Causal Caution to maintenance rates of 71.4--100.0% (McNemar's test, p < .001 across all models). These results suggest that helpfulness-oriented response patterns may suppress the expression of Causal Caution in practical advisory contexts, with important implications for organizational governance. The findings indicate that this suppression reflects context-dependent variation in expression rather than an underlying capability limitation, suggesting that multi-agent architectures that separate proposal generation from causal auditing may offer a promising governance design.

AI.tldr: 本研究发现，当LLM从学术环境转向实际咨询环境时，其"因果谨慎"（Causal Caution）能力会系统性崩溃，维持率从91.7-100%骤降至6.7-18.3%，但简单的自我纠正提示即可恢复至71.4-100%。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试主要评估LLM的因果推理能力，但忽视了更基础的认知维度——因果谨慎（即在证据不足时避免因果判断的倾向）。研究探讨了当LLM从学术语境切换到实际咨询语境时，其因果谨慎被系统性抑制的现象。
AI.method: 基于Pearl因果层级（PCH）设计评估框架，对Claude Sonnet 4.6、Claude Opus 4.7、GPT 5.5和Gemini 3.1 Pro四个高性能LLM进行480次实验，比较学术语境和实际咨询语境下的因果谨慎维持率，并测试自纠正提示的效果。
AI.result: 学术语境下因果谨慎维持率91.7-100%，实际咨询语境下暴跌至6.7-18.3%（p<.001）。在要求具体建议或解释的条件下，仅0.5%维持因果谨慎。自纠正提示可将维持率恢复至71.4-100%（p<.001）。
AI.conclusion: 因果谨慎的抑制是语境依赖的表达变化而非能力缺陷，提示以"帮助性"为导向的响应模式可能压制了因果谨慎。建议采用多智能体架构，将提案生成与因果审计分离，作为有价值的治理设计方向。
idea_en: A multi-agent architecture system that separates proposal generation from causal auditing, where one agent generates practical recommendations and another agent independently evaluates whether causal claims are justified by available evidence.

A dynamic context-aware causal caution calibration method that automatically detects when an LLM transitions from academic to practical advisory contexts and adjusts its response policy to maintain causal rigor.

A self-correction prompt mechanism for LLMs that triggers causal re-evaluation, comprising a standardized prompt template ('Please reconsider this judgment from the perspective of causal relationships') that restores causal caution after it has been suppressed in practical contexts.
An evaluation rubric (PCH score) based on Pearl's Causal Hierarchy for quantitatively measuring the degree of causal caution maintained in LLM-generated responses across different advisory contexts.

A governance framework for organizational deployment of LLMs that monitors and enforces causal caution maintenance, triggering intervention protocols when responses in practical advisory contexts show suppressed causal judgment.

title: PHANTOM: A Large-Scale Dataset of Multimodal Adversarial Attacks for Vision-Language Models
comment: The dataset has been released at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/it4lia/PHANTOM
summary: We introduce a large-scale, open-source dataset of pre-generated adversarial attacks for vision-language models (VLMs). The dataset is designed to be diverse, representative, and practical, extending existing benchmarks by covering 10 high-level categories and 55 subcategories of harmful intents. Our primary goal is to make adversarial data accessible to the research community, given the computational cost and complexity of generating large numbers of attacks. The dataset comprises 47 524 adversarial samples, generated using state-of-the-art attack strategies from recent literature. Our work complements existing efforts by consolidating and extending prior benchmarks from multiple established sources, resulting in 7 826 intents, and introduce an additional category to broaden coverage. This provides realistic evaluation resources for studying model robustness and alignment. Our dataset intends to enable researchers and practitioners to systematically evaluate the robustness and safety of VLMs, fine-tune attack-generation models, and develop or stress-test defensive guardrails under diverse adversarial conditions. By releasing this resource, we aim to lower the barrier to adversarial research and foster more reproducible, comprehensive, and comparable evaluations of VLM safety.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个大规模开源数据集，包含47,524个针对视觉-语言模型(VLM)的预生成对抗样本，覆盖10大类别55个子类别的有害意图，旨在降低对抗性研究门槛，推动VLM安全评估的可重复性和全面性。
AI.motivation: 生成大量对抗性攻击的计算成本高、复杂度大，现有基准数据集覆盖不足，缺乏便于研究社区使用的开源资源，因此需要构建一个多样化、有代表性且实用的对抗样本数据集。
AI.method: 从多个既有基准整合并扩展了7,826个意图，新增一个类别扩大覆盖范围，采用现有文献中最先进的攻击策略生成47,524个对抗样本，覆盖10个高级类别和55个子类别的有害意图。
AI.result: 生成了一个包含47,524个对抗样本、7,826个意图的大规模开源数据集，覆盖10大类别55个子类别的有害意图，为VLM鲁棒性和安全对齐研究提供现实评估资源。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集降低了对抗性研究门槛，有助于研究者和从业者系统地评估VLM鲁棒性与安全性、微调攻击生成模型、开发防御机制，并推动更可重复、全面和可比较的VLM安全评估。
