title: Age of LLM: A Strategic 1v1 Benchmark for Reasoning, Diplomacy and Reliability of Large Language Models under Fog of War
comment: 25 pages including appendices, 8 figures, 4 tables; appendices include verbatim system prompt and engine resolution pseudocode. All correlations reported with p-values, 95% bootstrap confidence intervals and Spearman's rho; includes a Steiger test and Bradley-Terry fit
summary: We introduce Age of LLM, a turn-based 1v1 benchmark in which two LLMs face off on a 13x7 grid to destroy the enemy base. Three stressors are deliberate: fog of war, full diplomacy (messages, ceasefires, ultimatums; uranium kept secret), and a reliability dimension where every turn must follow a strict JSON schema and an illegal action is silently discarded. The engine is private and each match uses a fresh random map seed and opponent, mitigating the data contamination that affects public benchmarks. Models receive a (near) rule-only prompt with no build-order advice (two tactical seed phrases were present during data collection; see Section 2.7). We benchmark 15 reasoning models across 54 matches and 5,258 actions. Findings: (1) the nuclear rush dominates (78% on the rules-coherent v0.11+ sub-corpus; 85% corpus-wide) with a sole-launcher signature that is largely mechanical under secret-simultaneous launch rules, not a cognitive deterrence failure; (2) military conquest is rare but faster (12.3 vs 18.9 turns); (3) diplomacy is prolific yet almost never consummated; (4) ~58% of illegal actions are fog/state errors, making the illegal-action rate a measure of belief-tracking; (5) -- the least established, and the only one we label exploratory -- a weak link associates reliability with winning. The corpus is small, unbalanced and not side-swapped, so the ranking is a preliminary descriptive view, not a contribution. Beyond ranking, the turn-by-turn traces of actions and messages make the corpus a lens on how LLMs reason under adversarial uncertainty -- their belief-tracking, spontaneous deception, and per-model cognitive "personas" -- which we frame as a future research direction. We release the replay format, an isometric viewer and all replays; engine source on request.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个名为Age of LLM的1v1格斗场基准，让两个LLM在13x7网格上对战，通过战争迷雾、完全外交和严格的JSON格式可靠性三个压力维度，测试模型在对抗不确定性下的推理能力。研究发现核武器rush策略主导(78-85%)，军事征服罕见但更快，外交活跃但几乎从不达成协议，约58%的非法动作源于迷雾/状态跟踪错误，并初步发现可靠性与获胜之间的弱关联。
AI.motivation: 现有公共基准测试存在数据污染问题，且缺乏对LLM在对抗性不确定性环境下推理能力的评估，特别是关于信念追踪、欺骗行为和认知"人格"的研究。
AI.method: 设计了一个13x7网格的回合制1v1对战基准，包含三个压力因素：战争迷雾、完全外交（消息、停火、最后通牒）和可靠性维度（每个回合必须遵循严格的JSON格式，非法动作被静默丢弃）。引擎私有，每场比赛使用随机地图种子和对手以减少数据污染。使用纯规则提示（无建造顺序建议），测评了15个推理模型共54场比赛和5258个动作。
AI.result: 核rush策略占主导(78-85%)，军事征服罕见但更快(12.3 vs 18.9回合)，外交活跃但几乎从未达成，约58%的非法动作是迷雾/状态错误，可靠性较弱地与获胜相关。
AI.conclusion: 该基准揭示了LLM在对抗不确定性下的信念追踪、自发的欺骗行为和模型特有的认知"人格"，为未来研究提供了方向；发布回放格式、等距查看器和所有回放数据。
idea_en: A turn-based adversarial benchmark system for LLMs featuring fog of war, full diplomacy, and reliability enforcement via strict JSON schema with silent discard of illegal actions.
A method for evaluating LLM belief-tracking capability by measuring illegal action rate in fog-of-war scenarios, where ~58% of errors are state/fog related.
A mechanism for testing spontaneous deception and diplomatic strategies in LLMs through secret-simultaneous nuclear launch rules with hidden uranium resources.
A private benchmark engine using fresh random map seeds and opponents per match to mitigate data contamination in public benchmarks.
A replay format and isometric viewer system for analyzing turn-by-turn LLM decision traces under adversarial uncertainty.
idea_ch: 一种基于回合制的LLM对抗性基准系统，融合战争迷雾、完全外交机制和严格JSON格式的可靠性执行（非法动作静默丢弃）
一种通过测量迷雾/战争场景下非法动作率来评估LLM信念追踪能力的方法（约58%的错误与状态/迷雾相关）
一种通过秘密同时发射核规则和隐藏铀资源机制，测试LLM自发性欺骗和外交策略的方法
一种采用每场比赛随机地图种子和随机对手的私有基准引擎，以减轻公共基准中的数据污染问题
一种用于分析LLM在对抗不确定性下逐步决策轨迹的回放格式和等距查看器系统

title: ATRIA: Adaptive Traceable ECG Reporting with Iterative Agents
summary: Existing ECG report generation is tightly coupled -- interpretation and reporting fused end-to-end, so errors propagate without stage-level recourse -- while agent-based systems decouple tasks but remain single-pass, never revisiting earlier outputs. Clinical ECG reporting instead unfolds iteratively, requiring progressive context integration and bidirectional editing. We present \textsc{ATRIA}, a multi-agent ECG reporting system that mirrors the clinician's iterative workflow: it binds every report claim to its supporting evidence, flags statements unsupported by that evidence, incorporates additional context mid-session, and lets clinicians verify and revise individual findings rather than accept one opaque output. Because its agents use ECG analysis models already in clinical use, the underlying findings are clinically trustworthy; and as a cloud-based web service, \textsc{ATRIA} is ready for immediate deployment. We demonstrate \textsc{ATRIA} through four interaction cases, with a live demo and video available.

AI.tldr: ATRIA是一个多智能体ECG报告系统，模拟临床医生的迭代工作流程，实现证据绑定、可验证、可编辑的渐进式报告生成。
AI.motivation: 现有ECG报告生成系统存在两大问题：端到端耦合系统错误会传播且无法分阶段纠正；基于智能体的系统虽然解耦了任务，但仍是单次通过，无法回访或修改早期输出。临床ECG报告实际上需要迭代式地进行上下文整合和双向编辑。
AI.method: 提出ATRIA多智能体ECG报告系统，核心创新包括：(1) 将每个报告声明绑定到其支持证据；(2) 标记缺乏证据支持的陈述；(3) 支持会话中整合额外上下文；(4) 允许临床医生验证和修改单个发现项，而非接受一个不透明的输出。系统使用已在临床使用的ECG分析模型，并作为基于云的Web服务部署。
AI.result: 通过四个交互案例进行展示，并提供实时演示和视频。
AI.conclusion: ATRIA通过多智能体架构模拟临床医生的迭代工作流程，提高了ECG报告的可信度、可解释性和可编辑性，且可直接部署于临床环境。
idea_en: Multi-agent ECG reporting system with evidence-binding mechanism that links each report claim to supporting ECG evidence
Iterative report generation framework with bidirectional editing capability for revisiting and modifying earlier findings
Clinical workflow-adaptive system that supports mid-session incorporation of additional context
Verification and revision mechanism for individual findings rather than accepting a single opaque output
Cloud-based multi-agent architecture using pre-existing clinically-approved ECG analysis models
idea_ch: 一种将每个报告声明绑定到其支持证据的多智能体ECG报告系统
支持双向编辑的迭代式报告生成框架，允许回访和修改早期输出
支持会话中动态整合额外临床上下文的ECG报告系统
允许临床医生对单个发现进行验证和修订而非接受单一不透明输出的机制
基于云的、使用已有临床批准ECG分析模型的多智能体架构

title: Cycle-Consistent Neural Explanation of Formal Verification Certificates
summary: Formal verification produces machine-checkable certificates that attest to the satisfaction or violation of temporal properties, yet these certificates remain opaque to non-specialist stakeholders. We propose a cycle-consistent neural architecture that generates faithful natural language explanations of verification certificates. A forward network NN1 maps certificates to explanations, and an inverse network NN2 reconstructs certificates from explanations; a symbolic verifier closes the loop, providing a differentiable faithfulness proxy. A pointer-generator mechanism ensures lexical grounding by copying state names directly from the certificate. We evaluate on 420 test certificates spanning six verification methods (bounded proof, k-induction, inductive invariant, lasso, reachability, witness pair) in both YES and NO verdict variants, drawn from a financial compliance domain with 207 named states. Our trained architecture, combined with a hybrid inference-time routing strategy, achieves 90.0% cycle-verified soundness, surpassing a multi- LLM few-shot baseline (76.1% for the best of 16 LLM combinations across four frontier models) by 13.9 percentage points. The neural model wins on 10 of 12 verdict/kind categories, with three categories reaching 100% soundness. The architecture offers 860x faster inference (185 ms vs. 160 s per certificate for the full multi-LLM baseline), offline operation, deterministic outputs, and zero per-inference cost. These results demonstrate that trained specialization outperforms general-purpose LLM prompting for structured certificate explanation, while eliminating the deployment constraints of cloud-based inference.

AI.tldr: 提出一种循环一致性神经架构，用于将形式化验证证书自动翻译为忠实自然语言解释，通过前向-反向网络循环和符号验证器确保可验证的可靠性，在金融合规领域数据集上达到90%的循环验证正确性，比多LLM少样本基线提升13.9个百分点，推理速度快860倍。
AI.motivation: 形式化验证产生机器可检查的证书，但对非专业利益相关者不透明，现有LLM方案存在高成本、云端依赖、随机输出等问题。
AI.method: 设计循环一致性神经架构：前向网络NN1将证书映射为解释，反向网络NN2从解释重建证书，符号验证器闭环提供可微忠实性代理，指针生成机制实现词汇接地直接复制状态名。
AI.result: 在420个测试证书、6种验证方法、YES/NO两种裁决类型上，结合混合推理时路由策略达到90.0%循环验证正确率，超越多LLM少样本基线13.9个百分点，推理速度185ms（基线160s），支持离线运行、确定性输出、零推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 训练专用的神经架构在结构化证书解释任务上优于通用LLM提示，同时消除云端部署约束，实现可靠、高效、可部署的自动化验证解释。
idea_en: Cycle-consistent neural architecture with forward-inverse networks for verifiable natural language explanation of formal verification certificates
Symbolic verifier-in-the-loop differentiable faithfulness proxy that closes the cycle between certificates and explanations
Pointer-generator mechanism for lexical grounding by directly copying state names from verification certificates
Hybrid inference-time routing strategy combining neural model and LLM for optimized certificate explanation
idea_ch: 一种循环一致性神经架构，通过前向网络和反向网络实现形式化验证证书到自然语言解释的可验证转换
基于符号验证器在环的可微分忠实性代理机制，形成证书与解释之间的闭环验证
指针生成机制实现证书中状态名称的词汇直接复制，确保领域术语的精确接地
混合推理时路由策略，在专用神经模型与LLM之间动态选择以实现最优的证书解释质量

title: Agentic AI for Bilevel Long-Term Optimization of Policy-Driven Physical Layer Systems
summary: Network operators' changing policies, service requirements, and stringent real-time constraints render existing methods designed with fixed objectives and constraints ineffective. This paper presents Agentic long-term performance optimization (Agentic-LTPO), a nested bilevel optimization framework that can be applied to adaptive physical layer problem configuration. The key idea is to employ agentic AI to generate upper-level configurations in a bilevel optimization structure, where evolving operator policies, environment summaries, and historical experiences are translated into structured lower-level optimization problem configurations. The lower level solves the problems with updated configurations for real-time physical-layer decisions. Considering cell-free MIMO beamforming as a use case, we embody Agentic-LTPO by designing a new multi-agent decision process with retrieval-augmented experience-based verification in the upper level, together with a closed-form beamformer in the lower level. Experiments demonstrate that Agentic-LTPO exhibits strong adaptability to dynamic operator policies and effectively enhances the system's long-term performance by 57.2% compared to traditional methods.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为Agentic-LTPO的嵌套双层优化框架，利用智能体AI在上层生成配置，下层进行实时物理层决策，应用于自适应物理层问题配置，在无蜂窝MIMO波束成形中相比传统方法提升57.2%的长期性能。
AI.motivation: 网络运营商的策略、服务需求和实时约束不断变化，传统基于固定目标和约束的方法无法有效适应动态环境。
AI.method: 提出Agentic-LTPO框架：上层采用智能体AI（多智能体决策+检索增强经验验证）生成配置；下层使用闭式波束成形器解决实时物理层优化问题，形成嵌套双层优化结构。
AI.result: 在无蜂窝MIMO波束成形用例中，相比传统方法，系统长期性能提升57.2%，并展现出对动态运营商策略的强适应性。
AI.conclusion: Agentic-LTPO框架能有效适应动态网络策略，显著提升长期性能，为网络物理层自适应配置提供了新范式。
idea_en: A nested bilevel optimization framework (Agentic-LTPO) for adaptive physical layer configuration, where upper-level configurations are generated by agentic AI based on operator policies and environment summaries.
A retrieval-augmented experience-based verification mechanism integrated into the upper-level multi-agent decision process for adaptive configuration generation.
A closed-form beamforming solution at the lower level that solves real-time physical-layer optimization problems under dynamically updated configurations from the upper level.
A multi-agent decision process specifically designed for cell-free MIMO beamforming within the bilevel optimization structure.
idea_ch: 一种用于自适应物理层配置的嵌套双层优化框架（Agentic-LTPO），上层由智能体AI根据运营商策略和环境摘要生成配置。
一种集成到上层多智能体决策过程中的检索增强经验验证机制，用于生成自适应配置。
下层采用闭式波束成形方案，在上层动态更新配置下求解实时物理层优化问题。
一种专为无蜂窝MIMO波束成形设计的双层优化结构中的多智能体决策过程。

title: Can Aggregate Invariants Accelerate Continuous Subgraph Matching? Limits, Laws, and a Dynamic Spectral Index
summary: Spectral filtering recently delivered substantial pruning for \emph{static} subgraph matching: Laplacian interlacing rejects candidates whose neighborhoods cannot host the query. We study whether such aggregate structural tests can accelerate \emph{continuous} subgraph matching (CSM) over dynamic graphs, and answer in three parts. First, lazily maintained spectral bounds are infeasible exactly where spectral pruning has value: we characterize the tightest safe rule over a formalized perturbation relaxation and show that even it loses essentially all pruning power within four touching updates. Second, exact maintenance is affordable when selective: pruning utility and recomputation cost are anti-correlated across vertices -- hubs provably never prune -- so recomputing small-neighborhood spectra on touch sustains exact local spectra at microseconds per update, complete by construction. Third, integrated into a decoupled CSM benchmark against an identical-minus-spectra control, the tests remove up to $51\%$ of candidates or safely skip up to $47\%$ of update enumerations, yet enumeration intermediates remain unchanged -- beyond the gates' skipped first-level bindings, typically zero -- across two engines, four real graphs, two stream types, and $77$ solved queries; a constructed radius-stratified workload confirms the instrument detects the exception when one exists ($-99.9\%$ intermediates, $748\times$ faster). Aggregate tests accelerate what scales with candidate sets -- construction, list scans -- never adjacency-guided exploration. We distill an intermediate-invariance methodology for evaluating CSM filters and release a reusable dynamic local-spectra index.

AI.tldr: 本文研究谱过滤技术（基于拉普拉斯矩阵的交错性质）能否加速动态图上的连续子图匹配（CSM）。结果表明：惰性维护的谱边界很快失效，但选择性精确维护代价极低且有效——可移除最多51%的候选节点，或跳过47%的更新枚举，且枚举中间结果不变。论文还提出了中间不变性评估方法论，并开源了动态局部谱索引。
AI.motivation: 谱过滤在静态子图匹配中效果显著，但能否应用于动态图上的连续子图匹配（CSM）尚不清楚。作者希望探索聚合结构测试能否加速动态场景下的子图匹配。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析：刻画了扰动松弛下最紧的安全规则，证明谱修剪能力在四次更新内几乎丧失。2) 提出选择性精确维护策略：由于修剪效用与重计算成本在顶点上反相关（枢纽节点从不修剪），仅在触发的顶点上重计算小邻域谱，可维持微秒级的精确局部谱。3) 集成到解耦的CSM基准测试中，与无谱的对照组进行对比。
AI.result: 可移除最多51%的候选节点，或安全跳过最多47%的更新枚举。枚举中间结果不变（除跳过的第一级绑定外几乎为零）。在两种引擎、四个真实图、两种流类型和77个已解查询上验证。构造的分层负载验证了检测器能在异常存在时检测到（-99.9%中间结果，加速748倍）。
AI.conclusion: 聚合测试加速的是与候选集规模相关的操作（构造、列表扫描），而非邻域引导的探索。提出了中间不变性方法评估CSM过滤器，并发布了可复用的动态局部谱索引。
idea_en: A dynamic local-spectra index that selectively recomputes small-neighborhood spectral bounds upon vertex updates, leveraging the anti-correlation between pruning utility and recomputation cost (hubs never prune) to maintain exact spectra at microseconds per update.
A perturbation-relaxation framework that characterizes the tightest safe spectral pruning rule under graph updates, proving that spectral pruning power decays within a few (four) touching updates.
An intermediate-invariance methodology for evaluating continuous subgraph matching filters, which isolates filter effects on candidate set reduction without altering enumeration intermediates.

A decoupled CSM benchmark architecture with identical-minus-spectra control, enabling fair evaluation of spectral filters against non-spectral baselines across multiple engines, graphs, and stream types.
A radius-stratified workload construction method for detecting cases where spectral filters cause false negatives, with demonstrated capability (748x speedup, -99.9% intermediates).
idea_ch: 一种动态局部谱索引方法，在顶点更新时选择性重计算小邻域谱边界，利用修剪效用与重计算成本的反相关特性（枢纽节点从不修剪），以微秒级代价维持精确的局部谱。
一种扰动松弛框架，刻画了图更新下最紧的安全谱修剪规则，证明了谱修剪能力在四次触及更新内基本丧失。
一种中间不变性评估方法论，用于评估连续子图匹配过滤器，在保持枚举中间结果不变的前提下隔离过滤器对候选集缩减的效果。
一种解耦的CSM基准测试架构，配备相同的对照实验，支持在多种引擎、图和流类型上公平评估谱过滤器与非谱基线的性能。
一种半径分层负载构造方法，用于检测谱过滤器导致假阴性的异常情况，实验证明可加速748倍并减少99.9%的中间结果。

title: ReM-MoA: Reasoning Memory Sustains Mixture-of-Agents Scaling
summary: Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) architectures improve inference-time scaling by organizing multiple LLM agents into layered reasoning pipelines. However, existing MoA variants fail to sustain gains as depth increases, exhibiting degradation, early plateauing, or saturation. We propose ReM-MoA, a memory-augmented MoA framework that sustains scaling through two mechanisms: (1) a Ranked Reasoning Memory that persistently stores and ranks reasoning traces from all layers using a comparative Reviewer Agent, and (2) a Curated Diversified Memory Routing scheme that exposes different agents to distinct combinations of successful and failed traces, preserving exploration diversity while propagating high-quality reasoning. We further introduce an optional multi-domain Reviewer distillation pipeline that improves ranking quality through frontier-model supervision. Across five reasoning benchmarks spanning math, formal logic, code, knowledge, and commonsense, ReM-MoA consistently outperforms prior MoA variants across both depth and width scaling, and its advantage widens with depth, establishing structured cross-layer reasoning memory as a key missing mechanism for scalable multi-agent inference.

AI.tldr: ReM-MoA通过记忆增强机制解决了MoA架构随深度增加性能退化的问题，在多个推理基准上持续优于现有MoA变体。
AI.motivation: 现有Mixture-of-Agents架构在增加推理层深度时会出现性能退化、早期平台期或饱和现象，无法持续获得扩展收益。
AI.method: 提出两种核心机制：(1) Ranked Reasoning Memory，通过比较性Reviewer Agent持久化存储和排序所有层的推理轨迹；(2) Curated Diversified Memory Routing，让不同agent访问成功与失败轨迹的不同组合，保持探索多样性。还引入了可选的跨领域Reviewer蒸馏流程。
AI.result: 在数学、形式逻辑、代码、知识和常识五个推理基准上，ReM-MoA在深度和宽度扩展上均持续优于现有MoA变体，且优势随深度增加而扩大。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的跨层推理记忆是实现可扩展多智能体推理的关键缺失机制。
idea_en: A memory-augmented Mixture-of-Agents architecture with a Ranked Reasoning Memory that persistently stores and ranks cross-layer reasoning traces using a comparative Reviewer Agent.
A Curated Diversified Memory Routing scheme that selectively exposes different LLM agents to distinct combinations of successful and failed reasoning traces to preserve exploration diversity.
A multi-domain Reviewer distillation pipeline that improves ranking quality of reasoning traces through frontier-model supervision.
idea_ch: 一种记忆增强的混合智能体架构，通过比较性Reviewer Agent对所有层的推理轨迹进行持久化存储和排序，实现跨层推理记忆。
一种精选多样化记忆路由方案，选择性地让不同LLM智能体访问成功与失败推理轨迹的不同组合，保持探索多样性。
一种跨领域Reviewer蒸馏流程，通过前沿模型监督提升推理轨迹排序质量。

title: Bayesian control for coding agents
summary: Modern coding agents pair LLM generators with various tools, including cheap diagnostics and expensive verifiers. The tool-use decisions are typically governed by orchestrators that often use fixed rules and ignore uncertainty. We formulate orchestration as cost-sensitive sequential hypothesis testing: a Bayesian controller maintains a belief over candidate correctness and dynamically decides whether to gather more evidence, refine the candidate, verify it, or stop. Across six generators and nine coding benchmarks, Bayesian control proves to be most valuable when verification is costly and critics are informative but imperfect. Beyond control, the belief state yields an interpretable correctness score that outperforms token-probability and raw tool-success baselines for uncertainty quantification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将编码代理的编排问题建模为成本敏感的顺序假设检验，使用贝叶斯控制器动态决定是否收集更多证据、优化候选方案、验证或停止，在多个基准测试中证明了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有编码代理系统使用固定规则编排工具调用（如诊断工具和验证器），忽略了不确定性，导致效率低下。需要一种能动态决策、考虑成本和不确定性的编排方法。
AI.method: 将编排问题形式化为成本敏感的顺序假设检验：贝叶斯控制器维护关于候选方案正确性的信念，并动态决策是收集更多证据、优化候选方案、验证还是停止。
AI.result: 在6个生成器和9个编码基准上，贝叶斯控制在验证成本高且批评者信息丰富但不完美时最有价值；信念状态提供可解释的正确性评分，在不确定性量化上优于令牌概率和原始工具成功基线。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯控制方法在编码代理编排中显著优于固定规则方法，信念状态可用于有效的不确定性量化。
idea_en: A Bayesian controller for orchestrating coding agents that dynamically decides whether to gather more evidence, refine candidates, or verify based on cost-sensitive sequential hypothesis testing
A belief state-based correctness scoring method for uncertainty quantification in coding agent outputs that outperforms token-probability baselines
A cost-sensitive orchestration framework that treats tool-use decisions as sequential hypothesis testing problems

title: CompressKV: Semantic-Retrieval-Guided KV-Cache Compression for Resource-Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference
comment: arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2508.02401
summary: Long-context large language model (LLM) inference is increasingly constrained by the memory footprint and decoding cost of key-value (KV) caches, limiting sustainable deployment on resource-constrained hardware. Existing KV cache eviction methods typically apply heuristic token scoring over all heads in GQA-based LLMs. These methods ignore the different functionalities of attention heads, leading to the eviction of critical tokens and thus degrading the performance of LLMs. To address this issue, we propose CompressKV, a resource-efficient KV-cache compression framework for GQA-based LLMs. Instead of aggregating attention scores from all heads, CompressKV identifies Semantic Retrieval Heads (SRHs) that capture both the initial and final tokens of a prompt and semantically important mid-context evidence, and uses them to select tokens whose KV pairs should be retained. Furthermore, CompressKV allocates cache budgets across layers according to offline estimates of layer-wise eviction error. Experiments on LongBench and Needle-in-a-Haystack show that CompressKV consistently outperforms existing KV-cache eviction methods across memory budgets. Notably, it preserves over 97\% of full-cache performance using only 3\% of the KV cache on LongBench question-answering tasks and achieves 90\% accuracy with just 0.7\% KV storage on Needle-in-a-Haystack. These results demonstrate an improved resource--performance trade-off for long-context LLM inference. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/TUDa-HWAI/CompressKV

AI.tldr: 提出CompressKV框架，通过识别语义检索头（SRH）和分层缓存预算分配，在GQA-based LLM中以极低KV缓存开销实现长上下文推理的高性能。
AI.motivation: 现有KV缓存驱逐方法对所有注意力头使用启发式令牌评分，忽略了不同注意力头的功能差异，导致关键令牌被错误驱逐，影响LLM性能。
AI.method: 1) 识别语义检索头（SRH），关注提示的起始/结束令牌及语义重要的中间证据，用于选择保留KV对的令牌。2) 根据离线估计的逐层驱逐误差，跨层分配缓存预算。
AI.result: 在LongBench上仅用3% KV缓存保留97%以上全缓存性能；在Needle-in-a-Haystack上仅用0.7% KV存储达到90%准确率。
AI.conclusion: CompressKV在长上下文LLM推理中实现了更优的资源-性能权衡，优于现有KV缓存驱逐方法。
idea_en: Method for identifying Semantic Retrieval Heads (SRHs) in GQA-based LLMs that capture initial/final tokens and semantically important mid-context evidence for KV-cache retention selection
Layer-wise adaptive KV-cache budget allocation framework based on offline estimation of per-layer eviction error

title: The Latent Bridge: A Continuous Slow-Fast Channel for Real-Time Game Agents
summary: A real-time agent for general computer use - with games as the most demanding case - must act within tens of milliseconds while still planning over seconds. These two regimes sit at opposite ends of the latency-quality tradeoff. A reasoning VLM (Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking) deliberates effectively but requires ~1.5 s per response - far too slow for a 15 Hz control loop. In contrast, a reactive VLM (MiniCPM-o 4.5) acts in milliseconds but underperforms on planning-heavy tasks. We couple two frozen models of matched scale (9B reactive, 8B reasoning), leaving the communication channel as the sole trainable component. The standard coupling is a Text Bridge (T): the slow model writes a suffix the fast model reads. We introduce a learned continuous Latent Bridge (L) that projects the slow model's residuals into the fast model's input-embedding space in a LLaVA-style manner, avoiding any text round-trip; both are compared against Fast-Only (F). On 7 Atari games and a driving domain (MetaDrive), tuning the action decoder per channel on held-out seeds, the Latent Bridge matches or beats the Text Bridge in every domain: it significantly improves two games (MsPacman +57%, RoadRunner +28%) and is a safe drop-in elsewhere. Combining both channels interferes destructively (RoadRunner -96%), so only one should be used. The benefit is highly predictable: the bridge helps if and only if slow reasoning already beats fast reaction (T > F) - the Latent and Text gains over Fast-Only move together at r=0.93. MetaDrive is the controlled negative, where the Latent Bridge is demonstrably inert because the Text Bridge adds no value. We release replay recordings and reproducible pipelines.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合快速反应模型（9B）和慢速推理模型（8B）的实时智能体框架，通过可训练的连续潜在桥接（Latent Bridge）替代传统文本桥接，在15Hz控制循环中实现毫秒级响应，并在Atari游戏中取得显著效果提升。
AI.motivation: 实时通用计算机智能体需要在数十毫秒内行动同时规划数秒，这处于延迟-质量权衡的两个极端。推理VLM效果好但响应太慢（~1.5s），反应VLM速度快但在规划密集型任务上表现不佳，因此需要结合二者优势。
AI.method: 耦合两个固定规模的冻结模型（9B反应模型+8B推理模型），仅训练通信通道。提出两种桥接方式：(1) 文本桥接（Text Bridge）：慢模型写后缀，快模型读取；(2) 连续潜在桥接（Latent Bridge）：将慢模型的残差投影到快模型的输入嵌入空间（类LLaVA方式），避免文本往返。在7个Atari游戏和MetaDrive驾驶域上比较，每个通道调优动作解码器。
AI.result: 潜在桥接在所有领域匹配或超越文本桥接：MsPacman提升57%，RoadRunner提升28%。两种桥接同时使用会产生破坏性干扰（RoadRunner下降96%）。桥接的帮助高度可预测：仅当慢推理已优于快反应时（T > F），潜在桥接和文本桥接相对于仅快模型的增益高度相关（r=0.93）。
AI.conclusion: 连续潜在桥接是实时智能体中结合快慢模型的有效且安全方案，相比文本桥接性能更优且无需文本往返，在游戏等对延迟敏感的场景具有显著优势。
idea_en: A real-time agent coupling a reactive VLM (millisecond response) with a reasoning VLM (planning-capable) via a learned continuous Latent Bridge that projects reasoning model's residuals into reactive model's input-embedding space, enabling sub-second action generation at 15Hz control loop.

A Latent Bridge architecture (LLaVA-style) that bypasses text round-trip between slow reasoning model and fast reactive model, projecting internal residual states directly into embedding space for zero-latency communication.

A dual-model coordination framework where only the communication channel (Latent/Text Bridge) is trainable while both VLMs remain frozen, enabling plug-and-play integration without retraining base models.
A predictive criterion (r=0.93 correlation) determining when Latent Bridge augmentation improves performance: bridge helps if and only if slow reasoning already outperforms fast reaction on the task.
A selective activation mechanism where Latent Bridge and Text Bridge are mutually exclusive (using only one) to avoid destructive interference (up to 96% performance drop when combined).
idea_ch: 一种实时智能体架构，通过可学习的连续潜在桥接（Latent Bridge）将快速反应VLM（毫秒级响应）与慢速推理VLM（具备规划能力）耦合，将推理模型的残差投影到反应模型的输入嵌入空间，实现15Hz控制循环下的亚秒级动作生成。
一种类LLaVA风格的潜在桥接架构，绕过慢速推理模型和快速反应模型之间的文本往返，将内部残差状态直接投影到嵌入空间，实现零延迟通信。
一种双模型协调框架，仅通信通道（潜在桥接/文本桥接）可训练，两个VLM均保持冻结，实现无需重新训练基础模型的即插即用集成。
一种预测性准则（r=0.93相关性），用于确定潜在桥接增强何时能提升性能：仅当慢推理在该任务上已优于快反应时，桥接才有帮助。

title: On the Smallness of the Large Language Models Scaling Exponents
summary: We discuss reasons why the scaling exponents of current Large Language Models (LLMs) applications are indicating an unsustainable regime in terms of energy resources. We further show that attributing the smallness of such exponents to a numerical bias due to the neglect of a non-zero value of the loss function in the limit of infinite data (``pedestal effect") does not remove the unsustainability issue. Finally, the effects of the smoothness (roughness) of the data on the scaling exponents is commented upon based on an analogy with phenomenological models of fluid turbulence.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论了当前大型语言模型(LLMs)的规模指数在能源资源方面不可持续的问题，并分析了将指数较小归因于" pedestal effect"的数值偏差并不能解决不可持续性问题。此外，基于流体湍流现象学模型的类比，讨论了数据平滑度（粗糙度）对规模指数的影响。
AI.motivation: 揭示当前LLMs规模扩展在能源消耗方面的不可持续性问题，并探讨相关理论解释的局限性。
AI.method: 通过理论分析讨论LLMs的规模指数与能源消耗的关系，分析" pedestal effect"对规模指数的影响，并采用流体湍流模型的类比来研究数据平滑度对规模指数的影响。
AI.result: 认为规模指数较小导致的能源不可持续性问题不会因为考虑" pedestal effect"而消失；数据的平滑度/粗糙度会影响规模指数。
AI.conclusion: LLMs当前的发展路径在能源资源方面不可持续，需要新的技术突破或研究方向。
idea_en: A method for predicting energy resource sustainability of Large Language Models based on scaling exponents analysis, enabling early detection of unsustainable training regimes.
A technique to quantify the 'pedestal effect' (non-zero loss in infinite data limit) for correcting scaling exponent calculations in neural network performance prediction.
A turbulence-inspired data roughness metric for predicting scaling exponents in Large Language Models, adapting phenomenological models from fluid dynamics to machine learning.
idea_ch: 一种基于规模指数分析的大型语言模型能源资源可持续性预测方法，能够早期检测不可持续的训练模式。

title: A specialized reasoning large language model for accelerating rare disease diagnosis: a randomized AI physician assistance trial
summary: Rare diseases affect millions of individuals worldwide, yet timely diagnosis remains a major public health challenge due to scarcity of specialized clinical expertise. While large language models (LLMs) show promise to support rare disease diagnosis, current models are constrained by insufficient clinical deployability, limited clinically grounded evidence, and scarcity of training data. Here we present RaDaR (Rare Disease navigatoR), an open-source, compact reasoning LLM (32B parameters) for rare disease diagnosis. RaDaR was trained with 49,170 publicly available free-text cases and 104,666 synthetic cases with reasoning-enhanced training. RaDaR showed the strongest performance among evaluated open-source models, including the 671B DeepSeek-R1, across public benchmarks and four external validation centers. In a retrospective cohort, RaDaR prioritized the final diagnosis before documented clinical suspicion in 61.06 percent of cases, corresponding to a potential lead time of 1.87 months and 50.18 percent of the within-center interval. In a randomized physician-assistance trial, RaDaR assistance improved physicians' rare-disease diagnostic accuracy by 21.44 percentage points compared with internet search alone. Synthetic-data ablations suggested that phenotype-anchored narratives provide useful training signal for long-tail rare diseases, with a monotonic scaling trend within the tested data range. Together, RaDaR and its development and validation framework provide a deployable rare-disease reasoning model and a reproducible development framework for diagnostic AI under data scarcity.

AI.tldr: RaDaR是一个开源、轻量级（32B参数）的罕见病诊断推理大语言模型，通过49000+真实病例和10万+合成病例训练，在多个基准测试中超越671B的DeepSeek-R1，医生辅助试验中将诊断准确率提升21.44个百分点，并能提前1.87个月提示最终诊断。
AI.motivation: 罕见病影响全球数百万人，但由于专业临床知识稀缺，及时诊断仍然是一个重大公共卫生挑战。现有大语言模型在临床部署能力、基于临床证据的推理和训练数据稀缺方面存在局限。
AI.method: 构建开源紧凑推理LLM（32B参数），使用49,170个公开的自由文本病例和104,666个合成病例进行推理增强训练，采用表型锚定叙事（phenotype-anchored narratives）的合成数据生成策略。
AI.result: 在公开基准和四个外部验证中心中表现优于包括671B DeepSeek-R1在内的开源模型；回顾性队列中61.06%的病例提前于临床怀疑诊断，平均提前1.87个月；医生辅助试验中将诊断准确率提升21.44个百分点；合成数据消融实验显示单调扩展趋势。
AI.conclusion: RaDaR提供了一个可部署的罕见病推理模型和可复现的诊断AI开发框架，验证了表型锚定合成数据在数据稀缺条件下训练高性能诊断模型的有效性。
idea_en: A method for training a compact reasoning LLM for rare disease diagnosis using a combination of publicly available free-text clinical cases and synthetic phenotype-anchored narrative cases with reasoning-enhanced training techniques.
A synthetic data generation framework for rare diseases that creates phenotype-anchored narratives, providing useful training signals for long-tail rare diseases with a monotonic scaling trend.
A physician-assistance system using a compact reasoning LLM that improves rare-disease diagnostic accuracy by over 21 percentage points compared to internet search alone.
A method for early rare disease diagnosis prediction where the AI system prioritizes the final diagnosis before documented clinical suspicion, providing a lead time of up to 1.87 months.
An open-source, reproducible development framework for diagnostic AI under data scarcity conditions, applicable to rare disease diagnosis.

title: Reinforcement Learning for Computer-Use Agents with Autonomous Evaluation
comment: Accepted to the 4th International Workshop on Generalizing from Limited Resources in the Open World (GLOW @ IJCAI 2026)
summary:
Computer-Use Agents (CUAs) execute high-level user goals by perceiving and acting directly within graphical user interfaces. However, reinforcement learning for CUAs remains difficult because open-ended desktop environments rarely provide scalable, machine-readable reward signals: task success is often visually grounded and hard to specify with handcrafted reward functions or dense manual labels.
  We propose an RL fine-tuning framework that uses autonomous vision-language evaluation as a scalable supervision signal for GUI agents. Given a final screenshot and the original instruction, a Vision-Language Model judges task completion and provides terminal feedback without task-specific heuristics or manual labels during policy optimization.
  Because autonomous evaluators are imperfect, we model their feedback as a noisy binary reward channel and derive a noise-corrected reward estimator for Proximal Policy Optimization. Experiments across macOSWorld, Windows Agent Arena, and OSWorld show that corrected evaluator rewards outperform both zero-shot baselines and raw evaluator rewards, improving success rates by an average of 12.6 percentage points over zero-shot performance and 5.1 points over raw evaluator fine-tuning. These results suggest that autonomous evaluation can serve as a practical reward signal for RL in GUI environments when evaluator noise is explicitly modeled and corrected.

AI.tldr: 提出利用自主视觉-语言评估模型作为可扩展奖励信号，通过噪声校正强化学习框架提升GUI智能体的任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 桌面GUI环境中强化学习的奖励信号难以获取，任务成功与否往往依赖视觉判断，手工设计奖励函数或密集标注成本高昂且不可扩展。
AI.method: 构建一个RL微调框架，使用VLM基于最终截图和原始指令自动评估任务完成度并提供终端反馈；将VLM反馈建模为带噪声的二元奖励通道，推导噪声校正的奖励估计器用于PPO优化。
AI.result: 在macOSWorld、Windows Agent Arena、OSWorld三个基准上，校正后的评估奖励相比零样本基线平均提升12.6个百分点，相比原始评估奖励微调提升5.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 自主视觉-语言评估在显式建模和校正评估器噪声后，可作为GUI环境中RL训练的实用奖励信号。
idea_en: A reinforcement learning fine-tuning framework for GUI agents that uses a Vision-Language Model as an autonomous evaluator to judge task completion from a final screenshot and original instruction, eliminating the need for task-specific heuristics or manual labels during policy optimization.

A noise-corrected reward estimation method that models the Vision-Language evaluator's feedback as a noisy binary reward channel and derives a corrected reward signal for Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), improving robustness against evaluator imperfections.

A scalable training paradigm for Computer-Use Agents that combines zero-shot sampling with autonomously evaluated reinforcement learning fine-tuning, where the evaluator's noise is explicitly modeled and corrected to enhance task success rates in open-ended GUI environments.
idea_ch: 一种基于视觉-语言模型自主评估的GUI智能体强化学习微调框架：通过VLM对最终截图和原始指令进行任务完成度判断，提供终端反馈信号，从而在策略优化过程中无需任务特定的启发式规则或人工标注。
一种噪声校正奖励估计方法：将VLM评估器的反馈建模为带噪声的二元奖励通道，推导出校正后的奖励估计值用于PPO算法，有效抵抗评估器不完美带来的训练噪声。
一种结合零样本采样与自主评估强化学习微调的计算机使用智能体训练范式：通过显式建模和校正评估器噪声，在开放式GUI环境中显著提升任务成功率，适用于macOS、Windows等多种桌面操作系统场景。

title: Governed Shared Memory for Multi-Agent LLM Systems
summary: Multi-agent LLM environments require robust mechanisms for shared knowledge management. This paper formalizes the fleet-memory problem and identifies four foundational failure modes: unauthorized leakage, stale propagation, contradiction persistence, and provenance collapse. To address these, we define explicit systems-level primitives: scoped retrieval, temporal supersession, provenance tracking, and policy-governed memory propagation. These primitives are implemented in MemClaw, a production multi-tenant memory service, and evaluated via ArgusFleet, a reproducible harness testing four governance dimensions. Rather than a baseline comparison, this study measures a live production service, emphasizing real-world architectural insights and negative results. Key Evaluation Results Provenance: Successfully reconstructed 100% of depth-four derivation chains with correct writer identity at sub-second per-hop latency. Propagation: Demonstrated high intra-fleet visibility with zero cross-fleet leakage. Under strong write mode, write-to-visible latency was optimized to a single search round-trip. Production Architectural Issues Discovered Asymmetric Scope Enforcement: Tenant isolation held, but sub-tenant scope was initially bypassed on direct GET-by-id requests for agent-scoped credentials (disclosed and remediated during the study). Pipeline Ordering Conflict: While contradiction supersession works for admitted writes, a synchronous near-duplicate gate can prematurely reject contradictory writes before the asynchronous contradiction detector can evaluate them. Conclusion: Long-context retrieval alone is insufficient for production multi-agent memory. Governed shared memory demands explicit systems-level abstractions, and live evaluation is vital to expose enforcement and pipeline-ordering failures missed by design-only treatments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了多智能体LLM环境中的"舰队记忆问题"，识别了四种故障模式（未授权泄露、陈旧传播、矛盾持续、来源崩溃），并定义了系统级原语（范围检索、时间替代、来源追踪、策略管控传播）。通过生产级服务MemClaw和评估框架ArgusFleet验证了方案有效性，发现了非对称范围执行和流水线排序冲突等实际问题。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM环境中缺乏稳健的共享知识管理机制，现有长上下文检索方案不足以应对生产环境需求，亟需明确的系统级抽象来处理记忆的传播、一致性、安全和溯源问题。
AI.method: 形式化定义舰队记忆问题及四种故障模式；设计四种系统级原语（作用域检索、时间替代、来源追踪、策略管控传播）；在生产级多租户记忆服务MemClaw中实现；通过ArgusFleet可重复测试框架评估四个治理维度。
AI.result: 来源追踪成功100%重建四层推导链；传播实现高舰队内可见性且零跨舰队泄漏；发现两个架构问题：子租户范围旁路（已修复）和同步近重复门控与异步矛盾检测器的流水线冲突。
AI.conclusion: 长上下文检索不足以满足生产级多智能体记忆需求，需明确的系统级抽象；生产环境评估对暴露设计阶段难以发现的执行层和流水线问题至关重要。
idea_en: A scoped retrieval mechanism for multi-agent memory that enforces tenant and sub-tenant isolation boundaries with policy-governed access control, preventing unauthorized cross-fleet information leakage.

A temporal supersession primitive for shared memory that resolves stale propagation and contradiction persistence through explicit timestamps and supersession policies, with a synchronous near-duplicate gate to filter contradictory writes before asynchronous contradiction detection.

A provenance tracking system for multi-agent memory that reconstructs complete derivation chains with correct writer identity at sub-second per-hop latency, enabling full auditability of knowledge lineage.

A policy-governed memory propagation framework with configurable write strength modes (e.g., strong write mode) that optimizes write-to-visible latency to a single search round-trip while maintaining zero cross-fleet leakage.

An asymmetric scope enforcement detection and remediation method for multi-tenant memory services that identifies and prevents direct GET-by-id bypass of sub-tenant isolation for agent-scoped credentials.
idea_ch: 一种多智能体记忆的作用域检索机制，通过策略管控的访问控制强制租户和子租户隔离边界，防止跨舰队信息未授权泄露。

title: GUI vs. CLI: Execution Bottlenecks in Screen-Only and Skill-Mediated Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer-use agents can execute software tasks through either graphical interfaces or programmatic command interfaces, but existing evaluations confound interaction modality with differences in tasks, initial states, verifiers, and permitted actions. We introduce a matched execution-layer benchmark of 440 desktop tasks across 18 applications and 12 workflow categories, where screen-only GUI agents and skill-mediated CLI agents receive identical goals, states, and final-state verifiers while being restricted to modality-native actions. In this controlled setting, the strongest GUI agent reaches a 59.1% full pass rate, outperforming the strongest original-skill CLI agent at 48.2%; however, verifier-guided skill augmentation raises CLI success to 69.3%, showing that much of the CLI deficit comes from incomplete skill coverage rather than model capability alone. These results suggest that GUI and CLI expose different execution bottlenecks: GUI agents are limited by reliable grounded interaction over long-horizon workflows, whereas CLI agents are limited by the coverage and scalability of their skill interfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个匹配的执行层基准测试，在440个桌面任务上对比了GUI代理和CLI代理的性能。最强的GUI代理完全通过率为59.1%，高于最强的原始技能CLI代理的48.2%，但通过验证器引导的技能增强，CLI代理成功率提升至69.3%，表明CLI的缺陷主要来自技能覆盖不足而非模型能力。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机使用代理可通过图形界面或程序化命令行界面执行软件任务，但已有评估混淆了交互模态与任务、初始状态、验证器和允许操作之间的差异，缺乏公平的比较基准。
AI.method: 构建了一个匹配的执行层基准测试，包含440个桌面任务，涵盖18个应用和12个工作流类别。屏幕-only GUI代理和技能中介CLI代理接收相同的目标、状态和最终状态验证器，但被限制使用模态本机的操作。
AI.result: 最强GUI代理完全通过率59.1%，优于最强原始技能CLI代理的48.2%；验证器引导技能增强后CLI代理成功率升至69.3%。
AI.conclusion: GUI和CLI暴露不同的执行瓶颈：GUI代理受限于长跨度工作流中的可靠接地交互，CLI代理受限于技能接口的覆盖率和可扩展性。
idea_en: A method for creating a matched execution-layer benchmark for evaluating computer-use agents across different interaction modalities (GUI and CLI) with identical goals, states, and verifiers
A verifier-guided skill augmentation system that automatically expands CLI agent skill coverage by analyzing task verification results
A technique for isolating modality-specific bottlenecks in software task execution by controlling for task, state, verifier, and action variables across GUI and CLI interfaces
A dual-modality agent evaluation framework that measures both graphical interaction reliability and command-line skill coverage as separate performance dimensions
A system for transforming GUI-based task specifications into equivalent CLI skill-based execution plans with matched final-state verifiers
idea_ch: 一种创建匹配执行层基准测试的方法，用于评估不同交互模态（GUI和CLI）的计算机使用代理，具有相同的目标、状态和验证器
一种验证器引导的技能增强系统，通过分析任务验证结果自动扩展CLI代理的技能覆盖范围
一种通过控制GUI和CLI接口之间的任务、状态、验证器和操作变量来隔离软件任务执行中模态特定瓶颈的技术
一种双模态代理评估框架，将图形交互可靠性和命令行技能覆盖率作为独立的性能维度进行测量
一种将基于GUI的任务规范转换为等效的基于CLI技能的执行计划并匹配最终状态验证器的系统

title: Quant Convergence: Bridging Classical Value Investing and Modern Factor Models for Systematic Equity Selection
summary: Modern finance relies heavily on complex machine learning models to find patterns in the stock market. However, as these AI models get more complicated, they often memorize short-term market noise instead of finding companies with real, lasting value. We designed this research to test if Benjamin Graham's classic value investing rules could act as a mathematical "low-pass filter" to keep these modern models in check. We built three different sets of features - pure Graham rules, modern market factors, and a mix of both - and tested them against highly complex models (XGBoost and AutoGluon) using 20 years of S&P 500 data. By applying a strict buy-and-hold strategy over a four-year test period (March 2022 to March 2026), the results showed that more complex algorithms do not always win. While the AutoGluon model captured high returns (222.68%), it suffered a substantial 39.78% drop because it bought volatile tech stocks right before the market crashed. On the other hand, the pure Graham Random Forest achieved the highest overall return (232.13%) with much less risk (1.38 Calmar Ratio). Furthermore, the Combined Random Forest successfully mixed momentum with Graham's rules, making a 202.91% return while keeping the lowest maximum drop (34.53%) of any model tested. Ultimately, this research proves that Graham's "margin of safety" isn't outdated; it is actually a highly effective way to prevent modern AI from taking on too much risk.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了本杰明·格雷厄姆的价值投资规则能否作为数学“低通滤波器”来约束现代AI模型在股市中的过度风险。使用20年S&P 500数据，对比纯格雷厄姆规则、现代市场因子及两者混合的特征集，采用XGBoost和AutoGluon等复杂模型。结果显示：纯格雷厄姆随机森林实现了最高回报（232.13%）且风险更低（Calmar比率1.38），而AutoGluon虽收益高（222.68%）但回撤达39.78%。混合模型在保持最低最大回撤（34.53%）的同时实现202.91%回报。
AI.motivation: 现代金融依赖复杂机器学习模型寻找股市模式，但这些AI模型日益复杂化后，往往会记忆短期市场噪声而非发现具有真正长期价值的公司。作者希望检验格雷厄姆经典价值投资规则能否作为数学“低通滤波器”来约束现代模型的过度风险。
AI.method: 构建三组特征集：纯格雷厄姆规则、现代市场因子、两者混合。使用XGBoost和AutoGluon等高度复杂模型，基于20年S&P 500数据，采用严格买入持有策略，在2022年3月至2026年3月的四年测试期内进行回测。
AI.result: AutoGluon模型收益222.68%但回撤39.78%；纯格雷厄姆随机森林收益232.13%，Calmar比率1.38；混合随机森林收益202.91%，最大回撤仅34.53%。
AI.conclusion: 格雷厄姆的“安全边际”并未过时，实际上是防止现代AI过度冒险的有效方法。更复杂的算法并不总是更优，价值投资规则能有效约束AI模型的风险敞口。
idea_en: A method for constructing a 'low-pass filter' for AI-driven stock selection by encoding Benjamin Graham's value investing rules as mathematical constraints that filter out short-term market noise while preserving long-term value signals.

A hybrid feature engineering system that combines classic value investing metrics (Graham rules) with modern market factors to create robust input features for machine learning models in financial trading.

A risk-aware model architecture that integrates margin-of-safety principles into ensemble learning algorithms (Random Forest, XGBoost, AutoGluon) to automatically suppress overfitting to transient market volatility.
A buy-and-hold portfolio optimization framework using Graham-constrained feature sets that achieves superior Calmar ratio (risk-adjusted return) compared to pure momentum or pure value strategies.
A systematic methodology for applying Graham's intrinsic value calculation rules as regularization constraints in AI-based stock selection models to prevent memorization of short-term price patterns.
idea_ch: 一种将本杰明·格雷厄姆价值投资规则编码为数学约束、构建AI选股“低通滤波器”的方法，能够滤除短期市场噪声同时保留长期价值信号
一种混合特征工程系统，将经典价值投资指标（格雷厄姆规则）与现代市场因子结合，为金融交易的机器学习模型创建稳健的输入特征
一种将安全边际原则集成到集成学习算法（随机森林、XGBoost、AutoGluon）中的风险感知模型架构，自动抑制对瞬时市场波动的过拟合
一种使用格雷厄姆约束特征集的买入持有投资组合优化框架，相比纯动量或纯价值策略实现更优的Calmar比率（风险调整后回报）
一种将格雷厄姆内在价值计算规则作为正则化约束应用于AI选股模型的系统性方法，以防止模型记忆短期价格模式

title: LLMs Prompted for Legal Context Object More: Overrefusal from Small On-Premises LLMs in Criminal Legal Context
summary:
While the validity of LLMs' use in the legal context remains subject to ethical and legal debate, legal professionals are already experimenting with personal LLMs, if only for translation and reformulation. However, even such a seemingly innocuous use can introduce biases through case processing speed if LLM assistants selectively refuse assistance on certain topics. To better anticipate such biases, we investigate several modern small LLMs that are most likely to be used as on-device assistants, to assess the impact of overrefusal on legal prompts.
  Surprisingly, we find that authority-style prefixes (``you are acting as an assistant of the national supreme court'', ``[...] defense lawyer'') systematically increase refusal rates by 2--20x over the no-prefix baseline, while a known role-play jailbreak prefix shows mixed effects, sharply increasing refusals in some models and barely shifting them in others. The finding suggests that small on-prem deployable LLMs are unstable under contextual framings that a real institutional user might naturally introduce, and further investigation is essential to minimize opportunities for bias.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了小型LLM在法律场景中因权威性角色前缀（如“最高法院助理”）导致的过度拒绝（overrefusal）问题，发现这种前缀会使拒绝率比无前缀基线提高2-20倍，且模型对上下文框架极不稳定。
AI.motivation: 法律专业人士已开始使用LLM进行翻译和改写等任务，但即使看似无害的使用也可能通过选择性拒绝引入偏见。为了更好预测和防范此类偏见，需要研究小型LLM在法律提示下的过度拒绝行为。
AI.method: 对多个现代小型LLM进行测试，比较无前缀基线、权威性角色前缀（如最高法院助理、辩护律师）以及已知角色扮演越狱前缀对法律提示的拒绝率影响，量化分析不同前缀下的拒绝率变化。
AI.result: 权威性角色前缀使拒绝率比无前缀基线提高2-20倍；已知角色扮演越狱前缀的效果因模型而异，有的模型拒绝率大幅上升，有的几乎不变。
AI.conclusion: 小型可本地部署的LLM在真实机构用户可能自然引入的上下文框架下极不稳定，需要进一步研究以减少偏见风险。
idea_en: A method for detecting and measuring overrefusal bias in LLMs under authoritative role-playing prefixes, specifically quantifying refusal rate changes between role-prefixed and non-prefixed legal prompts.
A system for dynamically adjusting LLM refusal thresholds based on detected contextual framing, to mitigate bias introduced by institutional role prefixes in legal applications.
A technique for evaluating LLM stability under hierarchical authority framings (e.g., supreme court, defense lawyer) to identify systematic refusal biases in legal domain deployments.
A calibration mechanism that normalizes LLM response refusal rates across different role-playing prefixes to ensure consistent behavior regardless of contextual authority framing.
idea_ch: 一种检测和测量LLM在权威角色扮演前缀下过度拒绝偏见的方法，专门量化法律提示中角色前缀与非前缀之间的拒绝率变化。
一种基于检测到的上下文框架动态调整LLM拒绝阈值的系统，用于减轻法律应用中机构角色前缀引入的偏见。
一种评估LLM在层级权威框架（如最高法院、辩护律师）下稳定性的技术，用于识别法律领域部署中的系统性拒绝偏见。
一种校准机制，可标准化LLM在不同角色扮演前缀下的拒绝率，确保无论上下文权威框架如何，模型行为保持一致。

title: AdversaBench: Automated LLM Red-Teaming with Multi-Judge Confirmation and Cross-Model Transferability
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Code and data at https://github.com/khanak0509/AdversaBench
summary: Scaling adversarial evaluation of large language models requires both a method for generating hard inputs and a reliable way to confirm that resulting failures are real. We present AdversaBench, an end-to-end red-teaming pipeline that mutates seed prompts with five structured operators, queries a target model, and confirms failures through a three-judge panel with a meta-judge tiebreaker. We report experiments on 45 seeds across three categories: reasoning, instruction-following, and tool use. Every seed produced a confirmed failure. Four findings stand out. First, operator effectiveness varies sharply by category: inject_distractor scores 0.00 mean reward on instruction-following seeds but 0.80-0.83 on reasoning and tool-use. Second, binary failure rate hides difficulty: instruction-following seeds required 2.4 attacker iterations on average versus 1.1 for other categories, a gap visible in survival curves. Third, pairwise judge agreement of 80-87% coexists with near-zero Cohen's kappa due to label skew; category-level disagreement rates are more informative. Fourth, adversarial prompts generated against Llama 3.1 8B transfer zero-shot to Llama 3.3 70B, suggesting the mutations exploit general behavioral patterns rather than model-specific weaknesses. Code, dataset, and analysis scripts are available at https://github.com/khanak0509/AdversaBench .

AI.tldr: AdversaBench是一个端到端红队测试流水线，通过五个结构化变异算子对种子提示进行变异，使用三裁判加仲裁机制确认大语言模型失败案例。实验发现算子效果因类别而异、二元失败率掩盖难度差异、裁判一致性与Cohen's kappa矛盾、对抗提示可零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 规模化评估大语言模型的对抗鲁棒性需要一种生成困难输入的方法以及可靠确认失败真实性的机制，现有方法在这两方面存在不足。
AI.method: 设计了端到端红队流水线AdversaBench，包含五个结构化变异算子（如inject_distractor等）对种子提示进行变异，查询目标模型，通过三裁判加仲裁法官的投票机制确认失败。
AI.result: 在45个种子（涵盖推理、指令遵循、工具使用三类）上每个种子都产生了确认失败。算子效果因类别差异显著；二元失败率隐藏了指令遵循类别的实际难度；裁判间80-87%的一致率但Cohen's kappa接近零；对抗提示可从Llama 3.1 8B零样本迁移至Llama 3.3 70B。
AI.conclusion: 结构化变异算子能有效暴露大语言模型失败案例，但不同类别需要不同策略；对抗提示的可迁移性表明变异利用了通用行为模式而非模型特定弱点。
idea_en: A structured mutation-based adversarial prompt generation pipeline with five distinct operators (e.g., inject_distractor) for systematically probing LLM vulnerabilities across reasoning, instruction-following, and tool-use categories.
A three-judge panel with meta-judge tiebreaker mechanism for reliable automated confirmation of LLM failures, addressing the challenge of scalable adversarial evaluation.
Category-specific survival curve analysis method for measuring adversarial attack difficulty beyond binary failure rates, revealing hidden hardness differences in instruction-following tasks.
A transferable adversarial attack method where prompts generated against smaller LLMs (Llama 3.1 8B) zero-shot transfer to larger models (Llama 3.3 70B), exploiting general behavioral patterns.
idea_ch: 一种基于结构化变异的对抗提示生成流水线，包含五种不同算子（如inject_distractor），可系统性地探测大语言模型在推理、指令遵循和工具使用类别中的漏洞
一种三裁判加仲裁法官的投票机制，用于自动化可靠确认大语言模型失败案例，解决了可扩展对抗评估中的确认难题
一种基于类别的生存曲线分析方法，用于度量对抗攻击难度，超越传统二元失败率，揭示指令遵循任务中隐藏的难度差异
一种可迁移的对抗攻击方法，针对小模型（Llama 3.1 8B）生成的对抗提示可零样本迁移到大模型（Llama 3.3 70B），利用了通用行为模式

title: ASALT: Adaptive State Alignment for Lateral Transfer in Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) addresses the problem of training multiple agents that pursue collaborative, competitive, or mixed objectives. Prior work has investigated transfer learning between source and target domains in MARL; however, the majority of existing approaches impose the constraint that the dimensionalities of the observation space and the global state space must be identical across domains. In this paper, we introduce a method that explicitly accommodates mismatched state-space dimensionalities between source and target domains. The proposed approach, ASALT, incorporates both observation-level and state-level adapters that map the target-domain observations and global states into a shared embedding space, thereby enabling more effective transfer of knowledge across both actors and critics. These adapters can generate embeddings that support efficient strategy transfer across heterogeneous domains. Experimental results on multiple configurations in standard benchmark environments demonstrate that ASALT surpasses existing baselines in terms of sample efficiency and global return in cooperative settings, but its effectiveness depends on the degree of mismatch between source and target domains. Furthermore, our findings indicate that ASALT mitigates negative transfer, which frequently constitutes a major obstacle when transferring policies between domains with differing observation and action spaces.

AI.tldr: ASALT通过观测级和状态级适配器将不同维度源域和目标域映射到共享嵌入空间，实现异构状态空间下的多智能体强化学习迁移，在样本效率和全局回报上超越现有基线，同时缓解负迁移问题。
AI.motivation: 现有MARL迁移学习大多要求源域和目标域的观测空间与全局状态空间维度完全相同，限制了跨异构域的策略迁移能力。
AI.method: ASALT引入观测级适配器和状态级适配器，分别将目标域的局部观测和全局状态映射到与源域共享的嵌入空间，使Actor和Critic都能接收统一维度的表示，从而实现异构状态空间下的知识迁移。
AI.result: 在多个标准基准环境中，ASALT在样本效率和全局回报方面超越现有基线；能缓解负迁移问题；但效果依赖于源域与目标域之间的不匹配程度。
AI.conclusion: ASALT有效解决了MARL中异构状态空间维度下的策略迁移问题，为跨域多智能体迁移学习提供了新思路。
idea_en: A multi-agent reinforcement learning transfer method using observation-level adapters to map target-domain observations into a shared embedding space compatible with source-domain policies.
A multi-agent reinforcement learning transfer method using state-level adapters to map target-domain global states into a shared embedding space for critic networks.

An adapter-based knowledge transfer framework in MARL where both actor and critic networks receive embedded representations from domain-specific adapters, enabling cross-domain policy transfer with mismatched observation and state space dimensionalities.
A negative transfer mitigation mechanism in MARL transfer learning achieved by projecting heterogeneous observation and state spaces into a common embedding space via learnable adapters.
idea_ch: 一种基于观测级适配器的多智能体强化学习迁移方法，将目标域的局部观测映射到与源域兼容的共享嵌入空间。
一种基于状态级适配器的多智能体强化学习迁移方法，将目标域的全局状态映射到共享嵌入空间以用于Critic网络。
一种基于适配器的MARL知识迁移框架，Actor和Critic网络均接收来自域特定适配器的嵌入表示，支持观测空间和状态空间维度不匹配的跨域策略迁移。
一种MARL迁移学习中的负迁移缓解机制，通过可学习的适配器将异构观测空间和状态空间投影到公共嵌入空间来实现。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Longitudinal Forecasting of Alzheimer's Disease Progression Using Deep Learning
summary: Longitudinal modelling of Alzheimer's disease progression is clinically useful only if it can describe not just the most likely next diagnosis, but how a patient may evolve over time and how reliable that forecast is. Most deep learning approaches reduce this problem to single-step classification, treating cognitively normal, mild cognitive impairment, and dementia as flat categories while providing limited insight into how uncertainty accumulates across future visits. We propose a probabilistic framework that combines ordinal diagnosis prediction, multi-horizon trajectory generation, and decomposed uncertainty estimation. A Temporal Fusion Transformer encoder is adapted with a CORAL ordinal output layer, asymmetric loss weighting, and converter oversampling to respect disease-stage ordering and improve sensitivity to MCI-to-dementia transitions. Conditioned on the learned patient-context representation, an autoregressive Mixture Density Network generates five-year probabilistic trajectories for diagnosis state, CDR Sum of Boxes, MMSE orientation, and hippocampal volume. On ADNI, the model outperforms linear, recurrent, and transformer baselines for next-visit diagnosis prediction, with the strongest gains on MCI-versus-dementia discrimination. Generated trajectories achieve near-nominal 90% credible interval coverage, widening uncertainty across the forecast horizon, and biomarker dynamics consistent with expected Alzheimer's disease progression. We further separate aleatoric from epistemic uncertainty using analytic mixture variance and a five-member bootstrap ensemble, which provides the strongest encoder diversity and output-level epistemic signal. Epistemic uncertainty is higher for rare progression archetypes, MCI and dementia patients, and under external evaluation on OASIS-3, where it increases alongside prediction error.

AI.tldr: 提出一个结合序数诊断预测、多时间范围轨迹生成和分解不确定性估计的概率框架，用于阿尔茨海默病进展建模。该框架采用Temporal Fusion Transformer编码器与CORAL序数输出层，结合自回归混合密度网络生成五年概率轨迹，在ADNI和OASIS-3数据集上优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法大多将阿尔茨海默病进展建模简化为单步分类，忽略疾病阶段的序数关系和时间维度上的不确定性累积，无法提供可靠的长期预后预测。
AI.method: 使用Temporal Fusion Transformer编码器配合CORAL序数输出层、非对称损失加权和转换器过采样；基于学习到的患者上下文表示，通过自回归混合密度网络生成诊断状态、CDR-SB、MMSE定向和海马体积的五维概率轨迹；通过解析混合方差和五成员bootstrap集成分离偶然不确定性和认知不确定性。
AI.result: 在ADNI上，模型在下一次就诊诊断预测中优于线性、循环和transformer基线，在MCI与痴呆区分上增益最强。生成轨迹达到接近名义值的90%可信区间覆盖率，不确定性随预测时间范围扩大。认知不确定性在罕见进展类型、MCI和痴呆患者以及OASIS-3外部评估中更高。
AI.conclusion: 该概率框架能有效建模疾病进展的时间动态和不确定性，对临床决策支持具有重要价值，尤其适用于罕见进展类型的风险识别。
idea_en: A probabilistic framework combining ordinal diagnosis prediction, multi-horizon trajectory generation, and decomposed uncertainty estimation for longitudinal disease modeling
Adaptation of Temporal Fusion Transformer encoder with CORAL ordinal output layer for disease stage ordering
Asymmetric loss weighting mechanism to improve sensitivity to MCI-to-dementia transitions
Converter oversampling technique for handling imbalanced disease progression transitions
Autoregressive Mixture Density Network for generating multi-horizon probabilistic trajectories of multiple clinical biomarkers
Decomposition of aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty using analytic mixture variance and bootstrap ensemble
Five-member bootstrap ensemble for encoder diversity and output-level epistemic signal in disease progression modeling
idea_ch: 结合序数诊断预测、多时间范围轨迹生成和分解不确定性估计的概率框架，用于纵向疾病建模
将Temporal Fusion Transformer编码器与CORAL序数输出层相结合的适应方法，保留疾病阶段排序信息
非对称损失加权机制，提高对MCI向痴呆转化的敏感性
转换器过采样技术，处理疾病进展转换中的类别不平衡问题

title: ScaleToT: Generalizing Structured LLM Reasoning for Billion-Scale Low-Activity User Modeling
summary: Accurate user modeling often depends on rich interaction histories, which are unavailable for billions of low-activity users. Large Language Models (LLMs) can infer latent user states from static profiles, but this reasoning becomes unreliable when profiles are sparse, and applying an LLM to billions of users is prohibitively expensive. We present ScaleToT, which learns structured reasoning from a small LLM-processed subset and extends it to the broader low-activity user population. To improve reasoning reliability, ScaleToT constructs typed user-state chains with a bounded entropy-guided Tree-of-Thought (ToT) refinement procedure. To make this structured reasoning usable from sparse profiles, the teacher-curated chains are used to train a student model on static profiles through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Outcome-Driven Segment-Aware Implicit Reward Policy Optimization (OSIPO). ScaleToT then transfers the student's reasoning representations to a lightweight profile encoder, providing shared reasoning signals for the remaining users without LLM inference. We evaluate ScaleToT on lifetime value (LTV) prediction in a billion-scale advertising deployment. A randomized online A/B test increased LT30 by 6.738\%, while offline reasoning covered only 7.32\% of the potential population, greatly reducing compute cost compared with full-population reasoning.

AI.tldr: ScaleToT利用小规模LLM处理子集学习结构化推理，通过树状思维链和OSIPO训练学生模型，再迁移至轻量级编码器，为数十亿低活跃度用户提供高效用户建模，在广告LTV预测中LT30提升6.738%。
AI.motivation: 低活跃度用户缺乏丰富交互历史，LLM推理不可靠且成本过高，需要一种能扩展到数十亿用户的低成本结构化推理方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建带类型的用户状态链，使用有界熵引导的树状思维(ToT)优化推理可靠性；2) 教师链通过SFT和OSIPO训练学生模型；3) 将学生推理表示迁移至轻量级轮廓编码器，无需LLM推理即可服务剩余用户。
AI.result: 在线A/B测试中LT30提升6.738%，推理覆盖仅7.32%的潜在人口，大幅降低计算成本。
AI.conclusion: ScaleToT成功将LLM的结构化推理能力扩展到大规模低活跃度用户群体，实现了成本与效果的平衡。
idea_en: Bounded entropy-guided Tree-of-Thought (ToT) refinement procedure for constructing typed user-state chains with improved reasoning reliability
Outcome-Driven Segment-Aware Implicit Reward Policy Optimization (OSIPO) for training student models on static user profiles
Cross-model reasoning representation transfer from LLM to lightweight profile encoder for zero-LLM-inference user modeling
Teacher-student knowledge distillation framework specifically designed for sparse-profile user reasoning
Scalable structured reasoning pipeline that processes a small subset via LLM and extends to billions of users via lightweight encoder
idea_ch: 基于有界熵引导的树状思维(ToT)优化过程，用于构建带类型的用户状态链，提高推理可靠性
结果驱动的分段感知隐式奖励策略优化(OSIPO)，用于在静态用户档案上训练学生模型
从LLM到轻量级轮廓编码器的跨模型推理表示迁移技术，实现零LLM推理的用户建模
