title: AI Tokenomics: The Economics of Tokens, Computation, and Pricing in Foundation Models
summary: Tokens have become the practical accounting unit for modern foundation model services, linking information processing, computation, memory use, energy expenditure, pricing, and economic value. This paper develops a framework for AI tokenomics: the study of how tokens are generated, consumed, priced, allocated, and optimized across AI systems. We connect token-level technical costs to workflow-level production functions, enterprise resource allocation, measurement and instrumentation methods, and emerging market-design questions. The framework shows that token expenditure and economic value are distinct: value depends on marginal productivity, workflow position, hidden reasoning activity, risk, and downstream propagation effects. The paper concludes by identifying open research directions in hidden-token measurement, empirical calibration, token productivity, dynamic allocation, and token-based markets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AI代币经济学（AI Tokenomics）框架，系统研究代币在AI系统中的生成、消耗、定价、分配和优化，指出代币支出与经济价值是不同概念，并识别了开放研究方向。
AI.motivation: 代币已成为现代基础模型服务的实际核算单位，连接信息处理、计算、内存使用、能耗、定价和经济价值，但缺乏系统性的理论框架来理解代币的经济学属性及其与价值的关系。
AI.method: 通过构建AI代币经济学框架，将代币级技术成本与工作流级生产函数、企业资源分配、测量方法及市场设计问题相连接，分析代币支出与经济价值的区别。
AI.result: 揭示了代币支出与经济价值是不同概念，价值取决于边际生产力、工作流位置、隐藏推理活动、风险及下游传播效应。
AI.conclusion: 识别了隐藏代币测量、经验校准、代币生产力、动态分配和基于代币的市场等开放研究方向。
idea_en: A token pricing method that dynamically adjusts based on marginal productivity and workflow position within AI systems, enabling value-based pricing rather than flat-rate token costs.
A hidden-token measurement and instrumentation system for detecting and quantifying unreported reasoning activities in large language model inference pipelines.
A token-based resource allocation optimization framework that accounts for downstream propagation effects and risk factors across multi-step AI workflows.
A token productivity tracking and calibration method that empirically links token consumption to actual task completion effectiveness.
idea_ch: 一种基于AI系统中边际生产力和工作流位置动态调整的代币定价方法，实现基于价值的定价而非统一费率。
一种隐藏代币测量与检测系统，用于发现和量化大语言模型推理管道中未报告的推理活动。
一种考虑下游传播效应和风险因素的代币资源分配优化框架，适用于多步骤AI工作流。
一种代币生产力追踪与校准方法，经验性地将代币消耗与实际任务完成效果相关联。

title: Abstractions of Queries in Ontology-Based Data Access
comment: Extended version of a paper published in the proceedings of KR 2025
summary:
In ontology-based data access (OBDA), multiple data sources are integrated via mappings to an ontology. We consider an OBDA setting based on existential rules and the certain answer semantics. We address the recent issue of query abstraction, which consists of abstracting data queries by translating them to the ontology layer. Since a perfect abstraction may not exist, the notions of minimally complete and maximally sound abstractions have been introduced.
  We study abstractions within an extension of UCQs with a limited form of inequality and a special predicate marking database constants. While this extension does not lead to an increased complexity of the problems of interest, it is able to express minimally complete abstractions, hence perfect abstractions when they exist. We also characterize maximally sound abstractions by making a new connection with the notion of maximum recovery stemming from data exchange.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于存在规则的OBDA系统中的查询抽象问题，提出了一种扩展的UCQ（带有限不等式和标记数据库常量的特殊谓词）用于表达最小完全抽象，并建立了最大可靠抽象与数据交换中最大恢复概念的新联系。
AI.motivation: 在基于存在规则的OBDA系统中，需要将数据查询抽象到本体层，但完美抽象可能不存在，因此需要研究最小完全抽象和最大可靠抽象。
AI.method: 扩展UCQ以包含有限形式的不等式和标记数据库常量的特殊谓词，利用存在规则和确定答案语义，并与数据交换中的最大恢复概念建立联系。
AI.result: 该扩展在不增加计算复杂度的前提下，能够表达最小完全抽象（从而在存在时表达完美抽象），并刻画了最大可靠抽象。
AI.conclusion: 扩展的UCQ查询语言在OBDA查询抽象任务中具有表达能力和计算优势，且与数据交换理论存在深层联系。
idea_en: A query abstraction method for OBDA systems based on extended UCQ with inequality predicates and a special predicate for marking database constants, enabling minimally complete abstractions.
A technique to compute maximally sound abstractions in OBDA by leveraging the concept of maximum recovery from data exchange theory.
A complexity-preserving extension of UCQ that expresses perfect abstractions when they exist, without increasing computational complexity.
idea_ch: 一种基于扩展UCQ的OBDA查询抽象方法，通过引入有限不等式和标记数据库常量的特殊谓词，实现最小完全抽象的表达。
一种利用数据交换中最大恢复概念来计算OBDA中最大可靠抽象的技术。
一种不增加计算复杂度的UCQ扩展方法，能够在完美抽象存在时表达它，同时保持计算效率。

title: When CQs Go Wrong: Challenges in CQ Verification with OE-Assist
comment: Acceted poster at https://2026.eswc-conferences.org/program/accepted-papers/poster-demo/ 23rd European Semantic Web Conference (Satellite Event)
summary: Competency Questions (CQs) are the central component of CQ-verification, an established process in which an ontology is evaluated against a set of natural language questions to determine whether the intended purpose of the ontology has been properly modelled. However, CQ-verification is often time-consuming and error-prone, as it requires careful interpretation of linguistic nuances and precise alignment with formal ontology constructs. Ambiguities and complexity in CQs can further complicate this process, leading to inconsistent modelling decisions and verification outcomes. In this paper, we investigate what makes a CQ challenging and possible solutions to enhance the users' performance in the CQ-verification process. We experimented with the data of 19 participants who performed CQ-verification on 20 tasks using an LLM assistant to support ontology evaluation. The results show the necessity of a tool to refine CQs before publishing them to avoid ambiguity or excessive complexity in later phases of the ontology engineering process.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了本体评估中能力问题（CQ）的挑战性因素，并通过19名参与者的实验证明，使用大语言模型（LLM）助手可以提高CQ验证的效率和准确性，提出了在发布前优化CQ以避免歧义和复杂性的必要性。
AI.motivation: 能力问题验证是本体评估的核心环节，但该过程耗时且易出错，因为需要仔细解释语言细微差别并与形式本体结构精确对齐。CQ中的歧义和复杂性会导致不一致的建模决策和验证结果。本文旨在探究CQ的挑战性因素及可能的解决方案，以提升用户在CQ验证过程中的表现。
AI.method: 通过19名参与者进行CQ验证实验，设计了20个任务，并使用LLM助手支持本体评估过程，分析CQ的挑战性特征及LLM助手的辅助效果。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，使用LLM助手可以提高CQ验证的效率和准确性，证实了在发布前需要一个工具来优化CQ，以避免后期本体工程阶段出现歧义或过度复杂性问题。
AI.conclusion: CQ验证过程中的歧义和复杂性是主要挑战，LLM助手能有效提升验证表现；建议开发CQ优化工具在发布前处理这些问题。
idea_en: A method for pre-processing competency questions (CQs) using LLM to automatically detect and resolve linguistic ambiguities before ontology evaluation.
An LLM-assisted CQ verification system that provides real-time suggestions for rephrasing complex CQs into simpler, unambiguous versions.
A tool for automatically generating formal ontology constructs from refined CQs to ensure alignment between natural language questions and ontology models.
idea_ch: 一种基于大语言模型的能力问题预处理方法，在本体评估前自动检测并解决语言歧义问题。
一种LLM辅助的CQ验证系统，可实时提供复杂CQ的重写建议，将其转化为更简洁、无歧义的版本。
一种从优化后的CQ自动生成形式化本体结构的工具，确保自然语言问题与本体模型之间的精确对齐。

title: Themis: An explainable AI-enabled framework for Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback
comment: The extended version of a paper published at the 2026 IEEE Conference on Artificial Intelligence (CAI). Includes an additional appendix with extended derivations and supplementary results. The main paper has 8 pages, 6 figures, 1 table
summary: Training safe Reinforcement Learning (RL) systems is inherently challenging, with no guarantee of avoiding unwanted behaviors. The most effective defenses against this are (i) transparency through explainability and (ii) alignment via human feedback. While both show promising results, no publicly available framework currently combines them. To address this, we introduce Themis, an XAI-enabled testing and evaluation framework for Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback. Themis supports over 200 widely used environments and is easily configurable for experiments in RL, transparency, and alignment. Our results show that Themis can train reward models that match or outperform the environment's true reward signal using human preferences. We also provide a cloud-based platform for collecting human feedback and managing experiments. It is user-friendly, auto-scalable, and supports large participant groups across multiple experiments without extra development overhead. Tests show Themis can support one thousand users in back-to-back experiments on a modest commercial machine.

AI.tldr: 提出了Themis，一个结合可解释AI（XAI）与人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）的测试评估框架，支持200+环境与云端平台，能训练媲美真实奖励信号的奖励模型。
AI.motivation: 训练安全的强化学习系统本身具有挑战性，无法保证避免不良行为。最有效的防御手段是（i）通过可解释性实现透明度和（ii）通过人类反馈实现对齐。两者虽有前景，但目前没有公开框架能将它们结合起来。
AI.method: 提出了Themis框架，是一个XAI-enabled的RLHF测试与评估框架，支持200+常用环境，可轻松配置RL、透明度和对齐实验。提供基于云的平台用于收集人类反馈和管理实验，具有用户友好、自动扩展等特点。
AI.result: Themis能够利用人类偏好训练出匹配或超越环境真实奖励信号的奖励模型；在普通商用机器上支持1000名用户进行连续实验。
AI.conclusion: Themis是首个结合XAI与RLHF的公开框架，有效提升了RL系统的安全性和透明度。
idea_en: A framework that integrates Explainable AI (XAI) with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) to enable transparent evaluation of RL agent behaviors.
A cloud-based auto-scalable platform supporting large-scale human feedback collection across multiple experiments simultaneously.
A reward model training method using human preferences that can match or outperform the environment's true reward signal.
A unified testing and evaluation framework supporting over 200 environments for RL, transparency, and alignment experiments.
An XAI-enabled system architecture that provides interpretable insights into why RL agents make specific decisions during training.
idea_ch: 一种将可解释人工智能（XAI）与人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）相结合的框架，用于透明评估RL代理行为
一种基于云的自动扩展平台，支持跨多个实验的大规模人类反馈收集
一种利用人类偏好训练奖励模型的方法，能够匹配或超越环境真实奖励信号
一种支持200多种环境的统一测试评估框架，用于RL、透明度和对齐实验
一种XAI驱动的系统架构，在训练过程中提供关于RL代理决策原因的可解释性洞察

title: SAFARI: Scaling Long Horizon Agentic Fault Attribution via Active Investigation
comment: Published at the Second Workshop on Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond (AIWILD) at ICML 2026
summary: As autonomous agents tackle increasingly complex multi-step, multi-agent tasks, their execution trajectories have scaled beyond the constraints of even the largest context windows. Current methods for effectively diagnosing agent failures load the full trajectory into an LLM's context window, which suffers from attention dilution and fails when agentic traces inevitably exceed context limits. To address this, we introduce SAFARI (Scaling long-horizon Agentic Fault AttRibution via active Investigation), a framework that replaces linear context loading with a tool-augmented diagnostic loop. By equipping LLMs with a specialized toolbox to read and search trajectory segments alongside a persistent Short-Term Memory (STM) for cross-turn reasoning, SAFARI effectively decouples diagnostic accuracy from architectural context limits. Our experiments demonstrate that SAFARI outperforms state-of-the-art results by 20% on the Who&When dataset within a 1M token budget, and by 19% on TRAIL GAIA subset on a 25K token budget. Most significantly, SAFARI maintains a 0.58 precision even when the target fault resides 5x beyond the model's native context window, a scenario where traditional evaluators fail entirely.

AI.tldr: SAFARI是一种框架，通过工具增强的诊断循环和短期记忆，取代线性上下文加载，实现对超长多步骤多智能体任务中的故障归因，即使故障位置超出模型原生上下文窗口5倍仍能保持0.58的精确度。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在诊断长序列多步骤智能体任务故障时，将完整轨迹加载到上下文窗口会导致注意力稀释，且当轨迹长度超过上下文窗口限制时完全失效。
AI.method: SAFARI用工具增强的诊断循环替代线性上下文加载：为LLM配备专用工具箱（读取、搜索轨迹片段），并引入持久性短期记忆（STM）支持跨轮推理，将诊断能力与架构上下文限制解耦。
AI.result: 在Who&When数据集上以1M token预算超越SOTA 20%；在TRAIL GAIA子集上以25K token预算超越SOTA 19%；当故障位置超出模型原生上下文窗口5倍时仍保持0.58精确度，传统评估器完全失效。
AI.conclusion: SAFARI验证了通过工具化搜索和记忆机制，可以有效突破上下文窗口的物理限制，实现超长序列下的准确故障归因。
idea_en: A tool-augmented diagnostic framework that replaces linear context loading with iterative search and retrieval of trajectory segments for fault attribution in long-horizon multi-agent tasks.
A persistent Short-Term Memory (STM) module that enables cross-turn reasoning across multiple diagnostic steps, decoupling fault analysis from single-context window constraints.
Specialized toolbox for LLMs to selectively read and search trajectory segments, preventing attention dilution by avoiding full-context loading.
A method for fault attribution that maintains diagnostic precision when target faults are located up to 5x beyond the model's native context window size.
idea_ch: 一种工具增强的诊断框架，用迭代搜索和检索轨迹片段替代线性上下文加载，用于长周期多智能体任务的故障归因。
持久性短期记忆（STM）模块，支持跨多次诊断轮的推理，将故障分析与单次上下文窗口限制解耦。
为LLM配备专用工具箱，选择性读取和搜索轨迹片段，避免全量上下文加载导致的注意力稀释。
一种在目标故障位于模型原生上下文窗口5倍之外时仍能保持诊断精度的故障归因方法。

title: CineCap: Structured Reasoning with Spatio-Temporal Anchors for Cinematographic Video Captioning
summary: Cinematographic captioning aims to describe how a video is filmed using professional film-language concepts such as camera movement, shot size, depth of field, composition, and shooting angle. This capability is important for fine-grained video understanding and controllable movie-quality video generation, yet remains underexplored in existing multimodal large language models. Unlike question-answering-based evaluation of cinematic understanding, cinematographic captioning requires a unified open-form description over multiple cinematographic dimensions. This task is challenging for two main reasons: the model must infer professional cinematographic concepts from subtle visual evidence, and it must generate captions that are both comprehensive and accurate. Accordingly, we propose CineCap, a framework that combines structured reasoning with spatio-temporal anchors and reinforcement learning with comprehensiveness, accuracy, and gated coverage rewards. The former grounds professional cinematographic descriptions in explicit visual evidence and organizes them into compact atomic reasoning for supervised fine-tuning, while the latter improves the balance between descriptive completeness and factual correctness. In addition, we construct CineCap Bench, a benchmark of 472 manually annotated video-caption pairs for systematic evaluation. Extensive experiments show that CineCap consistently outperforms strong proprietary and open-source baselines, establishing a new state of the art for cinematographic captioning. The code, model checkpoint, and benchmark are publicly available in https://github.com/Hectormxy/CineCap.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CineCap框架，结合结构化推理与时空锚点以及强化学习，实现电影摄影字幕描述，在专业电影语言概念（如镜头运动、景别、景深、构图、拍摄角度）上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型在电影理解方面缺乏对专业电影摄影概念（镜头运动、景别、景深、构图、拍摄角度）的细粒度描述能力，无法生成统一、开放式的电影摄影字幕。
AI.method: CineCap框架包含两个核心创新：1) 结构化推理结合时空锚点，将专业摄影描述锚定在显式视觉证据上，组织成紧凑的原子推理进行监督微调；2) 强化学习，包含完整性奖励、准确性奖励和门控覆盖奖励，平衡描述完整性与事实正确性。同时构建了包含472个手工标注视频-字幕对的CineCap Bench基准。
AI.result: 大量实验表明CineCap在电影摄影字幕任务上持续优于闭源和开源强基线模型，达到新的SOTA水平。
AI.conclusion: 结构化推理加时空锚点与强化学习相结合的方法是提升电影摄影字幕质量的有效途径，为细粒度视频理解和可控电影级视频生成提供了基础。
idea_en: A structured reasoning framework with spatio-temporal anchors that grounds professional cinematographic descriptions (camera movement, shot size, depth of field, composition, shooting angle) in explicit visual evidence via compact atomic reasoning, enabling supervised fine-tuning for cinematic captioning.

A reinforcement learning method with comprehensiveness reward, accuracy reward, and gated coverage reward for cinematographic captioning, which balances descriptive completeness and factual correctness in multi-dimensional open-form descriptions.

CineCap Bench: a benchmark of 472 manually annotated video-caption pairs specifically designed for systematic evaluation of cinematographic captioning across multiple professional film-language dimensions.
idea_ch: 一种结合时空锚点的结构化推理框架，通过紧凑的原子推理将专业摄影描述（镜头运动、景别、景深、构图、拍摄角度）锚定在显式视觉证据上，实现电影字幕的监督微调。
一种面向电影摄影字幕的强化学习方法，包含完整性奖励、准确性奖励和门控覆盖奖励，在多维度开放式描述中平衡描述完整性与事实正确性。
CineCap Bench基准数据集：包含472个手工标注视频-字幕对，专门用于对多维度专业电影语言概念的字幕生成进行系统评估。

title: LaGO: Latent Action Guidance for Online Reinforcement Learning
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Large Language Models for Planning (LM4Plan)
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for planning and sequential decision-making, but prior work often relies on using them as direct controllers, which requires precise action generation and can be unreliable in practice. This paper proposes Latent Action Guidance for Online Reinforcement Learning (LaGO), a framework that uses a pretrained LLM as a latent action prior to softly guide online policy optimization, rather than treating the LLM as an explicit planner or controller. Experiments on both a discrete-control benchmark, CLEVR-Robot, and a continuous-control benchmark, Meta-World, demonstrate that LaGO consistently improves both reward and success rate over Vanilla PPO. In particular, LaGO increases the average success rate from 15.1% to 27.2% on CLEVR-Robot and from 2.7% to 15.2% on Meta-World. Our analysis further shows that stronger pretrained LLMs provide more effective guidance, suggesting that LLM knowledge can improve planning and online decision-making.

AI.tldr: 提出LaGO框架，利用预训练LLM作为潜在动作先验软性引导在线策略优化，在离散和连续控制任务上显著提升PPO性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常将LLM直接作为控制器，需要精确动作生成，在实践中不可靠。希望利用LLM的知识但避免直接控制。
AI.method: LaGO框架：使用预训练LLM生成潜在动作先验（latent action prior），以软引导方式（softly guide）在线强化学习策略优化（PPO），而非直接输出具体动作。
AI.result: CLEVR-Robot平均成功率从15.1%提升至27.2%；Meta-World从2.7%提升至15.2%。更强的预训练LLM提供更有效的引导。
AI.conclusion: LLM知识可以以潜在先验形式有效改善在线规划和决策，软引导方式比直接控制更可靠。
idea_en: A method for soft guidance of online reinforcement learning policy optimization using a pretrained LLM as a latent action prior, where the LLM generates latent representations that bias the policy network's action selection without directly outputting explicit actions.

A framework (LaGO) that integrates a pretrained LLM into PPO training by converting LLM output into a latent action prior distribution that modifies the policy gradient update direction, enabling knowledge transfer from language models to policy learning in both discrete and continuous action spaces.

A technique for using LLM-generated latent priors to guide exploration in online RL, where the LLM's latent representation serves as a soft constraint that biases exploration toward semantically meaningful regions of the action space.
idea_ch: 一种利用预训练LLM作为潜在动作先验软性引导在线强化学习策略优化的方法，LLM生成潜在表征偏向策略网络的动作选择，而不直接输出显式动作。
LaGO框架：将预训练LLM集成到PPO训练中，通过将LLM输出转换为潜在动作先验分布来修改策略梯度更新方向，实现从语言模型到策略学习在离散和连续动作空间中的知识迁移。
一种利用LLM生成的潜在先验引导在线RL探索的技术，LLM的潜在表征作为软约束将探索偏向语义上有意义的动作空间区域。

title: Cost-Optimal Decision Diagrams for Stochastic Boolean Function Evaluation
summary: In many decision-making scenarios, acquiring information incurs different costs. We consider the problem of constructing a deterministic evaluation strategy that minimizes the expected cost of evaluating a propositional formula under variable costs and a probability distribution over truth assignments. We present a branch-and-bound algorithm with variable-selection heuristics, pruning, and caching. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first practical exact algorithm for this level of generality. Experiments on random instances demonstrate scalability and quantify the efficiency-quality trade-off of a greedy beam-search variant. We additionally evaluate a structured heart-disease diagnosis instance. Finally, we prove that the problem is $\#P$-hard and contained in $\mathrm{PSPACE}$.

AI.tldr: 提出首个实用的精确算法，用于在变量成本和概率分布下最小化命题公式评估的期望成本，包含分支定界、变量选择启发式、剪枝和缓存技术，并证明了问题的#P-hard性和PSPACE包含性。
AI.motivation: 在实际决策场景中，获取信息往往需要不同成本，而现有方法缺乏能在通用设置下精确求解期望评估成本最小化问题的实用算法。
AI.method: 提出分支定界算法，集成变量选择启发式策略、剪枝技术和缓存机制；同时设计了贪心波束搜索变体用于效率-质量权衡。
AI.result: 在随机实例上验证了可扩展性，量化了贪心波束搜索变体的效率-质量权衡，并在结构化心脏病诊断实例上进行了评估。
AI.conclusion: 该算法是首个针对此通用程度的实用精确算法，证明了问题属于#P-hard且包含于PSPACE。
idea_en: A branch-and-bound algorithm integrating variable-selection heuristics, pruning, and caching for minimizing expected evaluation cost of propositional formulas under variable-specific costs and probability distributions.
A greedy beam-search variant that provides tunable efficiency-quality trade-off for deterministic evaluation strategy construction.
Formal proof that the problem of minimizing expected evaluation cost for propositional formulas is #P-hard and contained in PSPACE.
idea_ch: 一种集成变量选择启发式、剪枝和缓存技术的分支定界算法，用于在变量特定成本和概率分布下最小化命题公式的期望评估成本。
一种贪心波束搜索变体，为确定性评估策略构建提供可调节的效率-质量权衡机制。
证明了命题公式期望评估成本最小化问题属于#P-hard且包含于PSPACE的正式数学证明。

title: Decentralised AI Training and Inference with BlockTrain
summary: Frontier AI training is increasingly shaped by access to dense, centrally controlled accelerator clusters. This creates a structural advantage for hyperscalers and large centralized laboratories, and makes open or independent AI efforts depend on scarce capital, privileged infrastructure, and data-center geography. We present Spheroid BlockTrain, a decentralized training protocol in which a model is partitioned into independently trainable blocks, each optimized on a local objective derived from the same global target and composed at inference into one model. On byte-level WikiText, BlockTrain reaches cross entropy 1.359 (perplexity 3.89), within about 0.04 CE of a same-setup end-to-end Transformer reference, while each active worker trains only one block and avoids full-model optimizer state. A shared six-worker block training run reaches CE 1.385 by averaging same-block updates into one assembled model. HTTP/TCP transport experiments move real serialized checkpoints and updates, including a public-IP three-host run that improves CE from 5.580 to 1.811 while moving 15.22 GB. For inference, the current BlockTrain path uses one block-stack traversal per full output and serves over direct TCP across three public-network GPU hosts up to a 75.80B-parameter logical fp16 shape, outperforming a matched plain-autoregressive TCP pipeline baseline because it emits a full sequence per WAN pipeline traversal rather than one token per traversal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Spheroid BlockTrain，一种去中心化训练协议，将模型分割成独立可训练的块，每个块基于全局目标优化的局部目标进行训练，推理时组合成一个模型。实验表明在字节级WikiText上达到交叉熵1.359（困惑度3.89），接近端到端Transformer参考模型，且每个工作节点只训练一个块，避免了全模型优化器状态。通过HTTP/TCP传输实现了公共IP多主机运行，并将逻辑参数规模扩展到75.80B fp16，性能优于纯自回归TCP流水线基线。
AI.motivation: 解决前沿AI训练对密集、集中控制的加速器集群的结构性依赖问题，打破超大规模云服务商和大型集中化实验室的垄断优势，使开放或独立AI研究不再依赖于稀缺资本、特权基础设施和数据中心地理位置。
AI.method: 提出Spheroid BlockTrain去中心化训练协议：将模型划分为独立可训练的块（blocks），每个块在源自同一全局目标的局部目标上独立优化，推理时组合成一个完整模型。采用多工作节点并行训练，每个工作节点只训练一个块，避免维护全模型优化器状态。使用HTTP/TCP传输协议分发序列化检查点和更新，支持公共IP多主机运行。
AI.result: 在字节级WikiText上：BlockTrain达到交叉熵1.359（困惑度3.89），与同设置端到端Transformer参考模型相差约0.04 CE。六工作节点块训练通过平均相同块更新达到CE 1.385。公共IP三主机运行将CE从5.580降至1.811，传输15.22 GB。推理方面，支持逻辑fp16格式高达75.80B参数的模型，优于纯自回归TCP流水线基线。
AI.conclusion: BlockTrain证明了一种可行的去中心化训练范式，能在不牺牲太多模型质量的前提下，显著降低单个参与者的计算和基础设施要求，为开放式AI研究提供了一条不依赖集中式大规模集群的替代路径。
idea_en: Method for partitioning a neural network model into independently trainable blocks, where each block is optimized on a local objective derived from a shared global target and composed at inference into a single model, enabling decentralized training across multiple workers without shared optimizer state

Decentralized training protocol that uses HTTP/TCP transport for serialized checkpoint and update distribution across public-IP GPU hosts, enabling model training across geographically distributed nodes

Block-stack traversal inference method that processes a full output sequence per WAN pipeline traversal rather than one token per traversal, improving throughput for large-scale models in decentralized networks
Technique for averaging same-block updates from multiple workers into a single assembled model, enabling distributed block training with consensus-based model merging
System for training neural network models exceeding 75B parameters on distributed consumer-grade GPU hardware by partitioning into independently trainable blocks
idea_ch: 一种将神经网络模型划分为独立可训练块的方法，每个块基于共享全局目标导出的局部目标进行优化，推理时组合为单一模型，实现无共享优化器状态的多工作节点去中心化训练
使用HTTP/TCP传输协议在公共IP GPU主机间分发序列化检查点和更新的去中心化训练协议，实现跨地理分布式节点的模型训练
基于块栈遍历的推理方法，每次广域网流水线遍历处理完整输出序列而非单个token，提高去中心化网络中大规模模型的推理吞吐量
将来自多个工作节点的相同块更新进行平均合并为单一组装模型的技术，实现基于共识的分布式块训练
通过将模型划分为独立可训练块，在分布式消费级GPU硬件上训练超过750亿参数神经网络模型的系统

title: Scaling Laws for Task-Specific LLM Distillation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across a growing range of domains, yet their scale poses deployment challenges in applications where latency and cost constraints are critical. This paper derives empirical scaling laws for domain-specific LLM compression, quantifying how in-domain and general knowledge performance scale with dataset size, compression ratio, supervision format, and iterative pruning schedule. Using quantitative finance as our application domain, we compare logit-based and LoRA-based distillation under iterative structural pruning, introducing a blended chain-of-thought supervision loss that stabilizes KL-divergence distillation over reasoning traces. In-domain task quality degrades predictably under compression while general-knowledge benchmarks collapse well before the same point; supervision format is the key driver of this tradeoff, with chain-of-thought supervision actively recovering general knowledge that pruning erases. We release the headline dataset FinHeadlineMix, scaling law results, and practical recommendations to provide a reusable framework for domain-specific compression decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了面向特定领域（量化金融）的LLM压缩经验标度律，量化了数据集大小、压缩比、监督格式和迭代剪枝调度对领域内与通用知识性能的影响，并引入了混合思维链监督损失来稳定推理轨迹上的KL散度蒸馏。
AI.motivation: LLM规模日益增长，在延迟和成本敏感的部署场景中面临挑战，需要有效的模型压缩方法，但目前缺乏针对特定领域的压缩标度律和系统化指导。
AI.method: 在量化金融领域，对比了基于logit的和基于LoRA的蒸馏方法在迭代结构剪枝下的表现；提出了混合思维链（chain-of-thought）监督损失，用于稳定推理轨迹上的KL散度蒸馏；构建了FinHeadlineMix数据集并进行了系统性标度律实验。
AI.result: 领域内任务质量在压缩下可预测地退化，而通用知识基准在更早的点就崩溃；监督格式是核心驱动因素，思维链监督能主动恢复被剪枝抹除的通用知识。
AI.conclusion: 发布了FinHeadlineMix数据集、标度律结果和实践建议，为特定领域的压缩决策提供了可复用的框架。
idea_en: A blended chain-of-thought supervision loss that stabilizes KL-divergence distillation over reasoning traces during iterative structural pruning of LLMs.

Domain-specific scaling laws for LLM compression that quantify the tradeoff between in-domain task quality and general knowledge retention under varying dataset sizes, compression ratios, supervision formats, and pruning schedules.
A method of using chain-of-thought supervision to actively recover general knowledge erased by structural pruning in domain-specific LLM compression.
Iterative structural pruning framework combining logit-based and LoRA-based distillation for domain-specific LLM compression with predictable performance degradation curves.
FinHeadlineMix: a domain-specific dataset (quantitative finance) designed for studying compression scaling laws in LLMs.
idea_ch: 一种混合思维链监督损失方法，用于在LLM迭代结构剪枝过程中稳定推理轨迹上的KL散度蒸馏。
面向特定领域的LLM压缩经验标度律，量化了数据集大小、压缩比、监督格式和剪枝调度下领域内任务质量与通用知识保留之间的权衡。
利用思维链监督主动恢复被结构剪枝抹除的通用知识的方法，适用于特定领域的LLM压缩场景。
结合logit基蒸馏和LoRA基蒸馏的迭代结构剪枝框架，用于特定领域LLM压缩，具有可预测的性能退化曲线。
FinHeadlineMix数据集：专为研究LLM压缩标度律设计的量化金融领域数据集。

title: Can Scale Save Us From Plasticity Loss in Large Language Models?
summary: The loss of plasticity - the ability of a network to learn new information after having already learned older information - is a fundamental challenge in creating artificial neural networks capable of continual learning. Although this phenomenon has been known for decades, it has mostly been studied in older, relatively small architectures and rarely in natural-language domains. To determine whether loss of plasticity remains a problem in the modern transformer-based LLM paradigm, we study plasticity loss in GPT-style Transformer models trained on a multilingual continual learning problem. Consistent with prior work, we find evidence of plasticity loss across models ranging from 5M to 314M non-embedding parameters, as measured by deterioration on a held-out Vietnamese probing task. We further find that the onset of plasticity loss follows a predictable scaling law, growing sublinearly with model size. These results suggest that larger models may delay the measurable effects of plasticity loss, but that increasing parameter count alone is likely to be insufficient to completely prevent it. We also find evidence of plasticity loss under stationary multilingual training, challenging the view that the phenomenon is exclusive to continual learning with abrupt task changes. Overall, our results suggest that even large Transformer language models trained on natural-language will eventually lose the ability to efficiently adapt to new data after sufficiently long training, in both continual and stationary settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Transformer大语言模型中的可塑性丧失问题，发现从5M到314M参数的GPT风格模型在连续学习和静态多语言训练中均出现可塑性下降，且遵循可预测的缩放定律。
AI.motivation: 可塑性丧失长期以来阻碍神经网络持续学习能力，但以往研究局限于小规模旧架构且罕见自然语言领域。本文旨在验证该问题在现代Transformer大语言模型中是否依然存在。
AI.method: 训练GPT风格Transformer模型（5M-314M非嵌入参数）执行多语言持续学习任务，通过在保留的越南语探针任务上的性能退化来度量可塑性丧失，并分析其与模型规模的关系。
AI.result: 发现所有规模模型均出现可塑性丧失，且其发生遵循随模型规模亚线性增长的可预测缩放定律；在静态多语言训练中也观察到可塑性下降，表明该现象并非持续学习独有。
AI.conclusion: 增大模型参数可延缓可塑性丧失的显现效应，但不足以完全阻止；即使是大型Transformer语言模型在长期训练后终将丧失对新数据高效适应的能力。
idea_en: A method for predicting plasticity loss onset in Transformer LLMs using scaling laws that grow sublinearly with model size, enabling proactive mitigation strategies.
A system for detecting and quantifying plasticity loss in large language models via performance degradation on a held-out probing task in a low-resource language.
A technique for maintaining plasticity in Transformer models through non-embedding parameter optimization strategies that counteract the sublinear scaling of plasticity loss.
idea_ch: 基于随模型规模亚线性增长的缩放定律来预测Transformer大语言模型可塑性丧失起始时间的方法，用于主动实施缓解策略。
通过在低资源语言（如越南语）的保留探针任务上的性能退化，检测和量化大语言模型可塑性丧失的系统。
通过优化非嵌入参数策略来维持Transformer模型可塑性，对抗可塑性丧失的亚线性缩放效应。
一种在静态多语言训练场景下检测和缓解可塑性丧失的方法，突破传统认知中该现象仅存在于任务突变式持续学习的局限。

title: BluTrain: A C++/CUDA Framework for AI Systems
summary: Progress in deep learning is, at scale, more a matter of systems engineering than of modelling: the behaviour of a model in training (its throughput, its memory footprint, and the numerical fidelity of the result) is determined less by the architecture itself than by how that architecture is expressed on the hardware. To achieve absolute control over this hardware expression while abstracting away systems complexity to make modelling seamless and eliminating the need for repetitive orchestration logic, BluTrain was architected from first principles as a robust, lightweight, and architecture-general training framework in standard C++ and the core CUDA programming model. Every layer is implemented natively: a typed tensor module with reverse-mode autograd, a linear-algebra library, a caching allocator, a multi-mode distributed-execution module, and an MLIR-based deep-learning compiler. In formal evaluations training a 124M-parameter GPT-2 baseline in FP32 on an 8-GPU 6000 Ada system, BluTrain outperforms industry-standard baselines in both throughput (sustaining an average of 407K tokens/s versus PyTorch's 395K tokens/s) and memory efficiency (achieving up to a 22% footprint reduction), while strictly preserving numerical fidelity and converging to a marginally lower final validation loss. With every layer explicitly open to native tuning, the performance ceiling is the framework's own to raise.

AI.tldr: BluTrain是一个从零构建的轻量级深度学习训练框架，使用标准C++和CUDA原生实现所有层（张量模块、线性代数库、缓存分配器、分布式执行模块、MLIR编译器），在8-GPU系统上训练124M参数GPT-2时，吞吐量达407K tokens/s（优于PyTorch的395K），内存占用降低22%，且保持数值精度不变。
AI.motivation: 深度学习进展在规模上更多是系统工程问题而非模型问题：模型在训练中的行为（吞吐量、内存占用、数值精度）更多取决于架构在硬件上的表达方式，而非架构本身。现有框架难以在抽象系统复杂性的同时提供对硬件表达的绝对控制，且需要大量重复编排逻辑。
AI.method: 从第一性原理构建BluTrain框架：1) 类型化张量模块+反向模式自动微分；2) 线性代数库；3) 缓存分配器；4) 多模式分布式执行模块；5) 基于MLIR的深度学习编译器。所有层均使用标准C++和核心CUDA编程模型原生实现，完全开放给原生调优。

AI.conclusion: 通过从硬件表达角度原生构建每一层，BluTrain能够在保持数值精度的同时提升吞吐量和内存效率，性能上限完全由框架自身决定，无需依赖外部库的优化限制。

title: Assessing Distribution Shift in Human Activity Recognition for Domain Generalization
summary: While the field of Human Activity Recognition (HAR) continues to draw interest from researchers and advance in important ways, some key challenges remain. One of the most difficult aspects of building HAR models that show good performance in real-world settings is dealing with data diversity from device and sensor heterogeneity, and contextual changes that are intrinsic to real-world applications. While data diversity in HAR has been well-acknowledged in the literature, there remains a gap in understanding the effect of various types of distribution shifts on HAR models and the domain generalization problem that arises. Towards that end, this paper systematically evaluates 4 different types of distribution shifts, including variations in device type, sensor placement, sampling rate, and user behavior. Quantifying their effects, we illustrate that diversity shifts predominantly define all types of shifts, indicating the existence of unique features that are not shared across different domains. We then introduce a uniform HAR-based distribution shift benchmarks and conduct a comprehensive evaluation of up to 28 domain generalization methods. Our analysis exposes the limitations of current domain generalization algorithms in achieving model generalizability, marginally outperforming the empirical risk minimization baseline. This work represents the first systematic exploration of domain generalization and adaptation concerning specific distribution shifts in sensor-based HAR, offering an open-source benchmark platform and datasets to spur further research.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了传感器人体活动识别(HAR)中4种分布偏移(设备类型、传感器位置、采样率、用户行为)对模型泛化能力的影响，发现多样性偏移主导了所有偏移类型。通过基准测试28种域泛化方法，揭示现有方法在HAR任务上仅略优于经验风险最小化基线。
AI.motivation: 尽管HAR领域已认识到数据多样性问题，但不同分布偏移类型对模型的影响及域泛化挑战尚未被系统理解。

AI.result: 多样性偏移主导所有偏移类型；现有域泛化算法在HAR任务上表现有限，仅略优于经验风险最小化基线。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个针对传感器HAR中特定分布偏移的域泛化和域适应系统探索，提供了开源基准平台和数据集。

title: Solving Inverse Problems of Chaotic Systems with Bidirectional Conditional Flow Matching
summary: Modeling chaotic systems is crucial yet challenging. Inverse problems in chaotic dynamics, namely inferring initial conditions from final states, remain largely unsolved because of ill-posedness, non-uniqueness, instability, and potentially chaotic time-reverse dynamics. We address this open problem with Bidirectional Conditional Flow Matching (Bi-CFM), which learns bidirectional mappings between distributions of initial and final states to capture the stochasticity of chaotic evolution and mitigate exponential error accumulation over time. Furthermore, for systems with conservation laws, we extend it to Conservation-constrained Bi-CFM (CBi-CFM). Across the classic Lorenz, Circuit, and high-dimensional Lorenz 96 systems, Bi-CFM improves five distribution-level metrics over baselines while achieving a speedup of more than two orders of magnitude. In the three-body planet-planet scattering problem in planetary dynamics, CBi-CFM better respects conservation laws, with conservation errors comparable to those of the ground truth. Finally, on real observations of globular clusters, collisional million-body systems shaped by $\sim 10^{10}$ years (10 Gyr) of evolution, our method represents an advance in accuracy, establishing a scalable route to solving inverse problems of long-timescale real-world chaotic dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双向条件流匹配（Bi-CFM）及其守恒约束扩展（CBi-CFM），用于解决混沌动力学中长期存在的逆问题（从最终状态推断初始状态），在多个经典混沌系统及真实天体观测中实现了精度和速度的显著提升。
AI.motivation: 混沌系统的逆问题（从终态反推初态）因不适定性、非唯一性、不稳定性及时间反演混沌性而基本未解决，亟需一种能处理混沌演化随机性并抑制指数级误差累积的方法。
AI.method: Bi-CFM学习初始状态与最终状态分布之间的双向映射，捕捉混沌演化的随机性并缓解时间上的指数误差累积；CBi-CFM进一步引入守恒律约束，适用于具有守恒量的系统。
AI.result: 在Lorenz、Circuit、高维Lorenz 96系统上，Bi-CFM在5个分布级指标上超越基线，且加速超过两个数量级；在三体行星散射问题中，CBi-CFM的守恒误差与真实值相当；在真实球状星团观测中，方法在精度上取得显著进步。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法为求解长时序真实世界混沌动力学的逆问题提供了一条可扩展的路径，在精度和效率上均表现出显著优势。

Conservation-constrained Bidirectional Conditional Flow Matching (CBi-CFM) that incorporates conservation law constraints into the flow matching framework for systems with conserved quantities.

title: Difference-Making without Making a Difference
summary: Over a series of seven papers, Andreas & Günther have introduced seven definitions of actual causation and have classified them as belonging to three different, competing, types of accounts: factual difference-making, counterfactual difference-making, and regularity-based. I show that their most recent - factual difference-making - definition instantiates all three types, thereby proving that these are distinctions without a difference. I further compare their novel account to the other six accounts on several crucial examples, revealing that this undermines all seven of their accounts.

title: Accuracy and Satisfaction in Multi-Turn LLM Dialogues for NFR Assessment
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to SIGDIAL 2026 (27th Annual Meeting of the Special Interest Group on Discourse and Dialogue)
summary: LLM-based dialogue assistants have become mainstream tools for software developers, yet current evaluation benchmarks focus exclusively on functional correctness. This leaves a critical gap in assessing the quality and accuracy of these conversations when handling Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs), which are inherently vague, context-dependent, and involve many parts of a program. Evaluating how well these systems support collaborative reasoning about NFRs requires methods that go beyond single-turn accuracy to capture both the correctness of the system's outputs and the quality of the multi-turn interaction. In this paper, we investigate the accuracy and quality of multi-turn conversations between developers and an LLM-based agent in the domain of Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) regulatory compliance. We hired 49 programmers to interact with GitHub Copilot to assess 148 HIPAA-derived NFRs against the iTrust codebase, a system designed to comply with HIPAA regulations, across three dimensions: requirement satisfaction level, reasoning, and code localization. We find that developers tend to agree with LLM assessments, but accuracy against expert ground truth is low. We model user satisfaction and find that longer system responses and more information-providing turns negatively affect user satisfaction, whereas proactive interactions positively affect it. Our findings provide insights for designing LLM-based dialogue systems that support NFR assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了开发者与LLM（GitHub Copilot）在HIPAA非功能需求合规评估上的多轮对话质量，发现开发者倾向于认同LLM的评估但准确率低，较长的系统回复和信息提供轮次会降低用户满意度，而主动交互则提升满意度。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM对话助手的评估基准仅关注功能正确性，忽略了非功能需求（NFRs）评估中的对话质量和准确性，而NFRs具有模糊性、上下文依赖性和跨程序多部分关联的特点，需要超越单轮准确率的评估方法。
AI.method: 招募49名程序员与GitHub Copilot进行多轮对话，评估148个HIPAA衍生的NFRs在iTrust代码库中的合规情况，从需求满意度、推理和代码定位三个维度进行测量。
AI.result: 开发者倾向于认同LLM的评估，但与专家标注的地面真实值相比准确性较低；较长的系统响应和更多信息提供轮次负向影响用户满意度，而主动交互正向影响满意度。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为设计支持NFR评估的LLM对话系统提供了见解，需要平衡信息提供与用户交互体验。
idea_en: A multi-turn dialogue system for assessing non-functional requirements compliance in codebases, with structured evaluation across satisfaction level, reasoning, and code localization dimensions.
A method for modeling user satisfaction in LLM-based NFR assessment dialogues, incorporating response length, information-providing turns, and proactive interaction as predictive features.
An evaluation framework for measuring LLM dialogue assistant accuracy in regulatory compliance (e.g., HIPAA) against expert ground truth, beyond functional correctness benchmarks.

title: Grading the Grader: Lessons from Evaluating an Agentic Data Analysis System
summary: Agentic data analysis systems produce rich outputs, including code, numerical results, and verbal diagnostics. This makes them more challenging to evaluate than single-turn LLM responses. It is therefore necessary to distinguish genuine disagreement between an agent's output and a ground-truth answer from grading artifacts. We investigate how reliably automated graders assess such a system and what strategies improve grading quality by applying LAMBDA, a multi-agent data-analysis system, on 153 numerical QRData tasks from DSGym. We develop and evaluate a three-layer human-AI grading cascade: strict regex matching, LLM-based lenient grading, and snippet-based human inspection, which combines non-GenAI and GenAI strategies with different failure profiles. Both automated graders achieve 100% observed precision (0/70 false positives). The lenient grader's recall is 97% against human labels. A keyword-anchored extraction pipeline raises the strict grader's recall by 60 percentage points over a last-number heuristic; the lenient grader is architecturally parser-independent. An iterative nudge mechanism raises grading run success from 36% to 97% and lenient-pass rates from 16% to 46%; comparing nudging with and without original-question re-injection shows that re-injection offers no benefit, confirming the nudge as an answer template cue. We further observe in this case study that variable type is the task metadata field most consistently associated with grading pipeline dynamics and observed outcome grades.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个三层人机协作评估级联（严格正则匹配、LLM宽松评分、基于代码片段的人工审查）对多智能体数据分析系统LAMBDA的153个数值QRData任务的评估效果。自动化评分器精确率100%，宽松评分器召回率97%；关键词锚定提取将严格评分器召回率提升60个百分点；迭代提示机制将评分成功率从36%提升至97%。发现变量类型是影响评估结果的关键元数据字段。
AI.motivation: 智能体数据分析系统输出内容复杂（含代码、数值结果和语言诊断），传统单轮LLM评估方法难以准确区分智能体输出与真实答案之间的真正分歧与评分伪影，需要更可靠的自动化评估方法。
AI.method: 构建三层人机评估级联：(1)严格正则匹配（基于关键词锚定提取管道）；(2)LLM宽松评分（架构无关的解析器）；(3)基于代码片段的人工审查。引入迭代提示机制提升评分成功率，并对比了是否重新注入原始问题对提示效果的影响。
AI.result: 自动化评分器精确率100%（0/70假阳性）；宽松评分器召回率97%；关键词锚定提取使严格评分器召回率提升60个百分点；迭代提示机制将评分成功率从36%提升至97%，宽松通过率从16%提升至46%；原始问题重新注入无额外收益，提示本质上是答案模板线索；变量类型是影响评估动态的最关键元数据字段。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的三层人机评估级联能有效评估智能体数据分析系统，非GenAI与GenAI策略可互补。迭代提示机制可显著提升评估鲁棒性，变量类型是评估可靠性的关键影响因素。

title: Matching Tasks to Objectives: Fine-Tuning and Prompt-Tuning Strategies for Encoder-Decoder Pre-trained Language Models
summary: Prompt-based learning has emerged as a dominant paradigm in natural language processing. This study explores the impact of diverse pre-training objectives on the performance of encoder-decoder pre-trained language models across generation and question answering tasks, with a focus on commonsense knowledge retrieval and completion. We highlight the benefits of incorporating multiple objectives during both pre-training and fine-tuning stages. We introduce the Match Task to Objective (MTO) framework and methods for determining the appropriate objective for a given task. This framework offers automated methods to prepare task-related data for adaptation through unsupervised training, based on the identified objective. In the fine-tuning stage, we design novel templates that align with the objectives of the pre-training and adaptation stages. When aligned with task requirements, these strategies can achieve a performance gain of over 120\% compared to conventional methods in few-shot settings. They significantly outperform related works in few-shot settings and exceed the baseline even in full-dataset scenarios. Furthermore, we extend this approach to include prompt-tuning methodologies, providing guidance for more effective soft prompt engineering and optimization. Our strategies significantly enhance prompt-tuning performance as well. These insights hold substantial value, precisely guiding the selection and optimization of models customized for specific tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/puraminy/MTO/

AI.tldr: 本文提出MTO（Match Task to Objective）框架，通过匹配预训练目标与下游任务目标，设计对齐的模板和自适应方法，在少样本和全数据集场景下显著提升编码器-解码器预训练模型的生成与问答性能，性能提升超过120%。
AI.motivation: 现有预训练语言模型在下游任务中表现各异，缺乏系统性的方法来匹配预训练目标与任务需求，导致模型潜力未被充分利用。
AI.method: 提出MTO框架，包含：(1)自动化方法确定任务对应的预训练目标；(2)基于识别目标的无监督训练数据准备；(3)设计对齐预训练/适应阶段目标的微调模板；(4)扩展至提示调优(prompt-tuning)的软提示工程优化。
AI.result: 在少样本设置中相比传统方法性能提升超过120%；在少样本设置中显著优于相关工作；在全数据集场景中也超越基线；提示调优性能也得到显著增强。
AI.conclusion: 匹配预训练目标与下游任务目标是一种有效的策略，能精准指导特定任务模型的选型和优化，具有重要实用价值。

Novel fine-tuning template design method that aligns with pre-training and adaptation objectives to maximize few-shot performance.
Extension of objective-aligned approach to soft prompt engineering, providing systematic guidance for prompt-tuning optimization.
Unsupervised adaptation data preparation method based on identified task-objective matching for improved model adaptation.

title: World Models in Pieces: Structural Certification for General Agents
summary: In the big-world regime, agents cannot be universally capable and their ability is inevitably specialized across a world model in pieces. Consequently, standard uniform guarantees fail to distinguish between the understanding of critical bottlenecks and irrelevant failures. We first formalize this limitation by proving that general agents are not universal, rendering standard worst-case analysis uninformative. To overcome this, we introduce structural certification, a transition-local framework that maps bounded goal-conditioned performance to entry-wise guarantees on the agent's internal world model. Our main contribution is constructive. We provide algorithms that filter specific transitions using deep compositional goals and prove that a general agent on these goals has a structural world model with a $\mathcal{O}(1/n) + \mathcal{O}(δ)$ error bound. Conversely, this bound is tight in the small-$δ$ regime, whose existence is explicitly guaranteed by our certification. These results enable the certifiable deployment of general agents by localizing the specific transitions where long-horizon planning is reliable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出结构化认证框架，通过深层组合目标过滤特定转换，证明通用智能体的世界模型具有O(1/n)+O(δ)误差界，实现大世界场景下智能体的可认证部署。
AI.motivation: 在大世界场景中，智能体无法普遍全能，能力必然在分片世界模型中专业化。标准统一保证无法区分关键瓶颈与无关故障，需要更精细的认证框架。
AI.method: 首先证明通用智能体不是万能的，标准最坏情况分析无效。提出结构化认证——一种转换局部框架，将有界目标条件性能映射到智能体内部世界模型的逐项保证。提供使用深层组合目标过滤特定转换的算法。
AI.result: 证明通用智能体在这些目标上具有O(1/n)+O(δ)误差界的结构世界模型，该界在小δ regime下是紧的，且其存在性由认证明确保证。
AI.conclusion: 通过定位长视野规划可靠的具体转换，实现通用智能体的可认证部署。
idea_en: A structural certification framework for mapping bounded goal-conditioned performance to entry-wise guarantees on an agent's internal world model, enabling localized reliability assessment in large-world scenarios.
A deep compositional goal filtering algorithm that selects specific transitions to prove structural world model properties with O(1/n) + O(δ) error bounds.
A transition-local certification method that distinguishes critical bottlenecks from irrelevant failures in agent capabilities, overcoming limitations of standard uniform guarantees.
A tight error bound certification system in the small-δ regime for general agents, explicitly guaranteed by the structural certification framework.
idea_ch: 一种结构化认证框架，将受限于目标条件的性能映射到智能体内部世界模型的逐项保证，实现大世界场景下的局部可靠性评估。
一种深层组合目标过滤算法，选择特定转换来证明具有O(1/n)+O(δ)误差界的结构世界模型属性。
一种转换局部认证方法，能够区分智能体能力中的关键瓶颈与无关故障，克服标准统一保证的局限性。
一种针对通用智能体在小δ regime下的紧误差界认证系统，其存在性由结构化认证框架明确保证。

title: OpenThoughts-Agent: Data Recipes for Agentic Models
summary: Agentic language models dramatically expand the applications of AI yet little is publicly known about how to curate training data for broadly capable agents. Existing open efforts such as SWE-Smith, SERA, and Nemotron-Terminal typically target a single benchmark, leaving open the question of how to train models that generalize across diverse agentic tasks. The OpenThoughts-Agent (OT-Agent) project addresses this gap with a fully open data curation pipeline for training agentic models. We conduct more than 100 controlled ablation experiments to systematically investigate each stage of the pipeline, yielding insights on the importance of task sources and diversity. We then assemble a training set of 100K examples from our pipeline and fine-tune Qwen3-32B on this dataset, which yields an average accuracy of 44.8% across seven agentic benchmarks and a 3.9 percentage point improvement over the strongest existing open data agentic model (Nemotron-Terminal-32B, 40.9%). Moreover, our training data exhibits strong scaling properties, outperforming alternative open datasets at every training set size in compute-controlled comparisons. We publicly release our training sets, data pipeline, experimental data, and models at openthoughts.ai to support future open research on agentic model training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了OpenThoughts-Agent (OT-Agent)项目，一个完全开源的数据筛选流程，用于训练通用的智能体语言模型。通过100多次消融实验，建立了10万条训练数据，在7个智能体基准上平均准确率44.8%，比最强开源模型高3.9个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有开源智能体模型（如SWE-Smith、SERA、Nemotron-Terminal）通常针对单一基准进行训练，缺乏能跨多种智能体任务泛化的训练数据构建方法。本文旨在填补这一空白，系统研究如何构建高质量、多样化的智能体训练数据。
AI.method: 1) 设计完全开源的数据筛选流程；2) 进行100多次受控消融实验，系统研究流程各阶段；3) 构建10万条训练数据；4) 基于Qwen3-32B进行微调；5) 在7个智能体基准上评估性能。
AI.result: 在7个智能体基准上平均准确率44.8%，比最强开源模型Nemotron-Terminal-32B (40.9%)提升3.9个百分点。训练数据表现出强缩放特性，在不同数据量下均优于其他开源数据集。
AI.conclusion: 开放数据筛选流程和高质量训练数据对训练通用智能体模型至关重要，任务来源和多样性是关键因素。项目完全开源以支持未来研究。
idea_en: A fully open data curation pipeline for training generalist agentic language models that generalizes across diverse agentic tasks beyond single-benchmark targeting.
A systematic ablation study methodology with over 100 controlled experiments to investigate each stage of agentic training data pipeline, revealing importance of task sources and diversity.
A 100K-example training dataset assembled from the pipeline with demonstrated strong scaling properties, outperforming alternative open datasets at every training set size.
A fine-tuning approach using Qwen3-32B on the curated dataset achieving 44.8% average accuracy across seven agentic benchmarks, improving 3.9 percentage points over prior best open model.
idea_ch: 一种完全开源的数据筛选流程，用于训练能跨多种智能体任务泛化的通用智能体语言模型，突破了现有方法仅针对单一基准的局限。
一种系统性的消融实验方法论，通过100多次受控实验研究智能体训练数据流程的每个阶段，揭示了任务来源和多样性对模型性能的关键影响。
由该流程构建的10万条训练数据集，展现出强缩放特性，在每种数据规模下均优于其他开源数据集。
一种基于Qwen3-32B在筛选数据集上微调的方法，在7个智能体基准上平均准确率达44.8%，比此前最佳开源模型提升3.9个百分点。
